body:

#
Hi Derek,
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in $5 or more to my grassroots campaign for U.S. Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-3?refcode=em20221012-7686&refcode2=7686_434096_p1Yf7Q&akid=7686%2E434096%2Ep1Yf7Q)** But first, I wanted to share with you some of my favorite moments from the campaign trail recently.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-3?refcode=em20221012-7686&refcode2=7686_434096_p1Yf7Q&akid=7686%2E434096%2Ep1Yf7Q)
Every weekend leading up to Election Day, my team + I have hit the road for rallies all across PA. We’ve visited MontCo, Philadelphia, Westmoreland County, Scranton, Erie, Pittsburgh, and most recently Bucks + York Counties...
We’ve filled union halls, school auditoriums, and gymnasiums. But my favorite was probably in Pittsburgh a couple weeks ago, where more than 600 folks came out in the pouring rain to rally with us downtown + launch our brand new campaign bus.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-3?refcode=em20221012-7686&refcode2=7686_434096_p1Yf7Q&akid=7686%2E434096%2Ep1Yf7Q)
It’s humbling to see so many people from across the Commonwealth come together and rally behind our grassroots campaign.
From union members, to parents and teachers, to service workers and more — I’m running to be the voice of real folks across PA and I’m so grateful you have my back.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-3?refcode=em20221012-7686&refcode2=7686_434096_p1Yf7Q&akid=7686%2E434096%2Ep1Yf7Q)
**[The movement we’ve built here in PA is so special, but we’ve gotta keep fighting to make sure we defeat Dr. Oz + flip this seat on November 8. So Derek, will you chip in $5 today to keep fueling our campaign forward through Election Day?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221012-3?refcode=em20221012-7686&refcode2=7686_434096_p1Yf7Q&akid=7686%2E434096%2Ep1Yf7Q)**

Thanks for being on this team, Derek. We couldn’t do this without you.
— John

Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

**First OH-01 Debate: Steve Chabot Highlights Fundamental Contrast Between His Record of Results and Opponent’s Support for Disastrous Tax-Hiking, Inflation-Fueling, Crime-Raising Agenda** _Former Pelosi Staffer Landsman Wrong Choice for Hardworking Families Facing Out-of-Control Grocery Costs and Crime in Their Neighborhood_
**For Immediate Release
** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released the following statement following the first televised debate of the race for Congress in Ohio’s First Congressional District on WLWT Channel Five. “Steve Chabot highlighted the fundamental contrast in the race for Congress tonight between his record of delivering results for hardworking families and small businesses and his opponent’s support for a disastrous tax-hiking, inflation-fueling, crime-raising agenda,” said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. “Just like Steve said tonight, southwest Ohio families deserve to be able to afford their groceries and walk down the street in their neighborhood without fearing violent crime.” “Former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman voted to raise taxes on families and small businesses eight times on the Cincinnati City Council, he called for an increase to the county sales tax, he voted to increase property taxes, he supported his former boss Pelosi’s most recent tax hike during a recession and her tax-and-spend policies that created 40-year-high inflation, and he wrote the plan to defund the police,” Gomez continued. “Southwest Ohio families who deserve relief from out-of-control inflation and rising costs and safe neighborhoods simply cannot afford Greg Landsman in Congress.” Get the facts on former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman’s record [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=d470ec57e3c945d79be0c60ab66b05db&_e=cV8zhw2ZSdQ60znXcBAEOcx7GHSxMpKAVjtqHKSSm9ANTEs4e95IzBr5FupM9YKL0Hu3CzTJlzc233cs4NKehcZ3tD0i5hDAJjW9L6f4Lr04oVdy7wh7ofIErnENrllF2JJGwLYRUlBd-MeQAhdlWG2qhxXrbm3E3rbDghkyX-jymP9YTbSOLXvIdrYES1ekbNVbz-fvA9v4gOaZJxQGFtvIjs5jh1t-AKD9pRRK07hMpgg7ekKyrBZCa7uoi79lB2erVm573NRXK04vzoyKtX0FYL-PzSfAmdThKTSQezTOyDc5IPqCY4oS18YnKWev3ZIhhsKETYGMnfoFTeUiVo85XUpXXCx1UxzEuJ9aIks%3D). Derek – I write to you today, not as an actor or a former
(fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our
Democratic Senate majority: Donald Trump just left Nevada where he held a
MAGA rally to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will
decide Senate control.

If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam
Laxalt (R) – if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose
the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power.

I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days
where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish
interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. That's why I need you to
join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto and
Adam Schiff protect this seat and our Democratic majorities.

Adam Schiff’s campaigns to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and
defend our Senate and House majorities?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Catherine Cortez Masto and Adam Schiff will go through
immediately:

I've been an activist my entire life, Derek. I've witnessed
moments where people came together by the thousands, by the millions, to
usher in great progress for this nation.

But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the
urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with
confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm
election.

If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they
flip this seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for
women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of
turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet
for the return of the impeached former president.

It's why Donald Trump himself flew all the way to Nevada to hold one of
his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and
begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and
that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win.

Democratic US Senate candidate John Fetterman is being smeared by the media. | | | The media came out today guns-blazing to take down Democrat John Fetterman, who is running against Republican Mehmet ("Dr.") Oz for the US Senate seat in Pennsylvania. The election is one month away. [**Will you join me in helping make sure Fetterman wins this?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zOsEpEbIMvY6QCovvAwhuDfUcS77hjKZl3roMT-1RaSs0mysrx65rO4nyli8Z-_8eSb5WOu0gPbmmTHuHeA_YVADs8DvPj0qiaGKBxgRH-PYWQWmixVqAR_nyXBysRCFMfzBetsVXkAqnGCvesQT4ste_vO2IXBsb6fjTzjdgiM9e2OJqKjPQdSa02_nD7Jw_jV4RiPeijI2x2bz6ZHr1gL_FUfrCDUca8pZwGZQgeqHfnqZkoA45nwJVICcwTnlgJ2mdFaFHdasdP11A_v_PHlE1dTi3Gu9rtj00O3mw0njllwyN6597YYDpPaOwZqbw/3q9/0KQy8gYKQGWaBOPag1cQMw/h0/YpojDPuxfzHpp4rsKSKM67IMhaCcPpJtCbgf0VNIADU) In an incredibly able-ist take on Fetterman's stroke from last May, the media are claiming that voters won't (shouldn't) like the fact that Fetterman is now using a word-to-text computer program to help him understand what people are saying. This is something the deaf have used for years, and no one would claim that someone deaf is unfit for office. Such a low-blow is to be expected from someone like Oz, who is a Trumper. But from the media? Would any of these reporters write a piece claiming that voters would/should be uncomfortable with Gob. Abbott of Texas simply because he uses a wheelchair? No, they wouldn't. Because they know discrimination against people with disabilities is wrong. At least, when it's a Republican. The latest polls have Fetterman ahead, but the race is tightening with one month to go. And this latest smear surely won't help. clean_body: Democratic US Senate candidate John Fetterman is being smeared by the media. | | | The media came out today guns-blazing to take down Democrat John Fetterman, who is running against Republican Mehmet ("Dr.") Oz for the US Senate seat in Pennsylvania. The election is one month away. In an incredibly able-ist take on Fetterman's stroke from last May, the media are claiming that voters won't (shouldn't) like the fact that Fetterman is now using a word-to-text computer program to help him understand what people are saying. This is something the deaf have used for years, and no one would claim that someone deaf is unfit for office. Such a low-blow is to be expected from someone like Oz, who is a Trumper. But from the media? Would any of these reporters write a piece claiming that voters would/should be uncomfortable with Gob. Abbott of Texas simply because he uses a wheelchair? No, they wouldn't. Because they know discrimination against people with disabilities is wrong. At least, when it's a Republican. The latest polls have Fetterman ahead, but the race is tightening with one month to go. And this latest smear surely won't help. **** “If life starts at conception, why do you care what age the heart starts beating at? # **Thelander Exposes Pingree's Record, Out of Touch Positions at Tonight's Debate**
---
|
---
| | _21-yr Navy SEAL vs. Politician Who Has Never Passed a Bill_
PORTLAND -- Ed Thelander, Navy SEAL and candidate for Maine's 1st Congressional District, tonight introduced himself to Maine voters and showed why he should be in Congress. Thelander also made plain why Chellie Pingree has failed to effectively represent them.

Thelander emphasized that on November 8 you have a clear choice.

"Chellie Pingree has one of the worst records for showing up to work in DC. She is one of the top 20 proxy voters of the 435 members of Congress.

Chellie Pingree does not get work done when she’s there. She has never passed a bill into law in the 14 years that she has said she represented you.

Chellie Pingree is divisive. She throws red meat to her base to raise money for her re-election.

We need someone who will represent us by showing up. I guarantee I will do that. My wife will see to that. You will see to that.

And when I get there, I will work tirelessly for six years with an objective at the end that I will have made life better here in Maine, and in America."

Thelander also pointed out that Pingree receives support from groups that call for defunding the police, while earlier today he received the endorsement from the Maine Association of Police, a group that represents the majority of police in Maine. Pingree also receives funding for her campaign from anti-lobstering groups, while his support for Maine's iconic industry is well-documented.

– _Ed Thelander, Republican candidate for Maine’s 1 st Congressional District, is a 21-veteran of the Navy SEAL Teams and resides in Bristol, where he is an active volunteer in his community._

clean_body: 21-yr Navy SEAL vs. Politician Who Has Never Passed a Bill | | | | | | | Thelander Exposes Pingree's Record, Out of Touch Positions at Tonight's Debate | | | 21-yr Navy SEAL vs. Politician Who Has Never Passed a Bill PORTLAND -- Ed Thelander, Navy SEAL and candidate for Maine's 1st Congressional District, tonight introduced himself to Maine voters and showed why he should be in Congress. Thelander also made plain why Chellie Pingree has failed to effectively represent them. Thelander emphasized that on November 8 you have a clear choice. "Chellie Pingree has one of the worst records for showing up to work in DC. She is one of the top 20 proxy voters of the 435 members of Congress. Chellie Pingree does not get work done when she’s there. She has never passed a bill into law in the 14 years that she has said she represented you. Chellie Pingree is divisive. She throws red meat to her base to raise money for her re-election. We need someone who will represent us by showing up. I guarantee I will do that. My wife will see to that. You will see to that. And when I get there, I will work tirelessly for six years with an objective at the end that I will have made life better here in Maine, and in America." Thelander also pointed out that Pingree receives support from groups that call for defunding the police, while earlier today he received the endorsement from the Maine Association of Police, a group that represents the majority of police in Maine. Pingree also receives funding for her campaign from anti-lobstering groups, while his support for Maine's iconic industry is well-documented. – Ed Thelander, Republican candidate for Maine’s 1 st Congressional District, is a 21-veteran of the Navy SEAL Teams and resides in Bristol, where he is an active volunteer in his community. | "Click to Donate $100" | "Click to Donate $250" | "Click to Donate $500" | "Click to Donate $1000" | | Ed Thelander is a United States Navy veteran. Friends, Good news to share with you... According to a new [AJC/UGA poll](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=2441651.557.1.fdf7ee80fd10399ebb89b6eff81578ae) released on Wednesday, Governor Brian Kemp now has a double digit lead over radical liberal Stacey Abrams. **That's right. With weeks until Election Day, the Governor is up by 10 points - 51% to 41%. The momentum is clearly on our side!** Here's the bad news... According to recent campaign finance reports filed last week, [Abrams raised $36 million over the past three months](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=2441651.558.1.33d00db03b2db4001d321cb5423a88a7) \- that's $8 million more than the sitting Governor. And with $11 million Cash On Hand, we know that her campaign is about to flood the airwaves with ads championing Abrams' extreme agenda and attacking Governor Kemp's conservative leadership. **We are poised for victory...but now is NOT the time to rest.** Early Voting starts next week and we are still $3,250 shy of our digital fundraising goal. If you haven't chipped in, can you donate right now? Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

ELECTION COUNTDOWN

Peter,

Between September 30 and October 1, 2022, U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers working at El Paso area ports of entry seized 17.21 pounds of fentanyl, 13.62 pounds of methamphetamine and 10.75 pounds of cocaine. This is happening almost every day at the southern border.

We work hard to achieve the American dream, and generations before us. With one presidency, it's been erased due to an open border allowed by the radical left. Drug dealers, sex traffickers, and career criminals are allowed to roam the streets on our dime.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

This poll might've been conducted by a Democrat firm who worked for Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden - but we can't take anything for granted.

**_This race is too important to sit on the sidelines and let my opponent claim he 's leading._**

Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. [**I 'm counting on hearing from you in the next 30 minutes.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61605144:JlsUlUVYN:m:1:3350876382:FBF250ACA229E482330321D63216B0B5:r)

For America,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61605145:JlsUlUVYN:m:1:3350876382:FBF250ACA229E482330321D63216B0B5:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Candace Owens
subject: White Lives Matter
body:
Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing “White Lives Matter” shirts. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6189%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=cvQQy0pLc5fZ99CYd9auCw&sysid=1)
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87141%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LWSdAVTkkHhJp%2bWmZ149yw&sysid=1)

Friend,

Wow. I broke the internet by posing with Kanye West wearing “White Lives Matter” shirts.

[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87141%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LWSdAVTkkHhJp%2bWmZ149yw&sysid=1)

“Why?” you may ask.

As Kanye West said, “I perform for an audience of one - and that’s God.” We all matter. We should not be divided. We need to come together and not allow radical groups and the media to divide us.

Kanye West also said “Utopia is possible for not who we are being led by.” I’m tired of pretending that radical groups like BLM are helping Black and urban communities.

I’m on a personal mission to bring pro-Family, pro-Freedom, and pro-Faith values to Black and urban communities. That’s why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[_**Can I count on you to support your fellow Americans and the BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87142%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5Cysmm3LiDLhZfaw7MAd0w&sysid=1)

Here are the facts that no one in the media want to talk about when it comes to Black communities:

**No one wants to talk about the 117,626 Black children who were killed by surgical abortion in 2018. 20 MILLION Black babies aborted in total.

Obesity is the number one killer in America and Black women have the highest rates of obesity. 56.9% are obese. But no one talks about it.

No one wants to talk about Black on Black crime. According to CDC, Black Americans are 4x more likely to be killed by homicide than anyone else. And what NO ONE wants to say is Black Americans account for 40% of homicide offenders.

No one wants to talk about the failing Black education. 74% of Black boys in California could not pass a basic reading comprehension test.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities.

In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. How does that compare to the numbers above?

[_**Please consider supporting BLEXIT Foundation with a gift of $10, $25, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your donation >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87143%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dI2V8ENgfj8O9iMi0uLPkw&sysid=1)

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87144%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D9OLqsqUZDb4FNZgmqjvyQ&sysid=1)

[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87259%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RT7hV31FwfahlVN8c%2b4wBA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87250%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JRnt2cd6A8GaMGeSz9fMzg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87251%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=swoSyUNapoBuyIyjzZ2fTQ&sysid=1)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87252%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OHrqKNNtjkEPnfi0vHuH5g&sysid=1)

Kanye shared a great message from his creative director about this.

_**“One needs to have courage and persistence to truly assume their identity and who they really are. Every day becomes a battlefield to defend this unique identity.”**_

This is a feeling I know all too well. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. This message is heartbreaking, and I still face that today.

It’s the message the media pushes on Black and minority communities.

_We’re told we’re victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. _

This is simply not true.

BLEXIT is showing how a pro-Family, pro-Faith, and pro-Freedom mindset can lift up Black and urban communities. **Our message is about UNITING people -_that means all people_ \- not division. **

[_**Your support empowers, awakens, and inspires millions of minorities to pursue the American dream and shape their own futures. Please send your generous gift today and help them find their BLEXIT >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87253%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lOdSmY%2bEQtenY4d5udMkBw&sysid=1)

**Here’s how BLEXIT Foundation is helping.**

Friend, BLEXIT State Chapters are the hands and feet of our Foundation. That’s why I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 this month to support our state chapters.

**BLEXIT Chapters provide opportunities for people to engage with their communities through social engagement, educational activities, community service, and virtual events.**

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice** : Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

[_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87254%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=w%2b%2fjofIPj776qCe8XM8LUw&sysid=1)

* **Pro-police Criminal Justice Reform** : The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87265%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wLF%2fXRD%2bNi%2fS2F9n4FnXnQ&sysid=1)

* **Entrepreneurship** : I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87266%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QWN2%2fL4wBTjNVGCWytvbJA&sysid=1)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87267%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jE17LsEQvBGlgwBJwW50fQ&sysid=1)

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message.

What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

**Friend, can you help the next generation have the courage to stand up for their beliefs? Click below to donate.**

The Establishment is dividing America by gender, race, politics, and belief systems. They would rather us focus on criminals like George Floyd than discussing the real issues hurting Black communities. In 2020, only 9 unarmed Black men were killed by police. We’re told we’re victims, nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is simply not true. I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** My opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to come clean.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**
Chuck Grassley is blanketing the state with TV ads attacking me. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are raising boatloads more. | | | Summer Update |

| The Mississippi Freedom Caucus has been busy this summer preparing for the 2023 legislative session. Our goal is to keep you informed and up-to-date about your government. Take Action today and help the Mississippi Freedom Caucus fight for your rights and Liberty.| [](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/m7EMZHIyMKKiiWXGNi6GUw)Click and Join the Mississippi Freedom Caucus
---
* * *

| Congratulations, You Now Owe $2,085.59! |
---|---|---
| |
---
Joe Biden believes he has the authority to unilaterally force $2,085.59 worth of someone else's personal student loan debt onto you and every other taxpaying American. So, in the words of Dr. Phil, ask yourself, "How does that make you feel?"

[Read More](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/YI7zUDB7ZmvAQsX5Ot9gIw)
* * *

| Buying Votes with Other Peoples Money |
---|---|---
| |
---
A few years ago, I believed the current policy makers were trying to buy votes. Today I am certain they are pursuing destruction of all that is good in our nation. "Student debt forgiveness" is a prime example. This Administration is fostering a weak and lazy generation that views hard work and determination in pursuit of success and family as foolishness.

[Read More](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/pkK1oNcRTAc_XbIWs4MNWA)
* * *

| Why are you paying for gender reassignment surgery for children? |
---|---|---
| |
---
You read that correctly, you, the taxpayers of Mississippi, are paying for children to receive hormone therapy and for mutilation of children.

[Read More](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/S9sq2_b-HTjIp-8O1fM84A)
* * *

| Election Integrity |
---|---|---
| |
---
Election integrity is an important aspect of a free society. Voting and choosing who will represent us in government is a duty that every citizen must exercise. The key word in that sentence is "citizen". A nation can not remain free, nor can we truly have a representative government if the representatives are selected by someone other than those being governed.

[Read More](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/np9Ez8pN1n-jbnV4VNAhgg)

| Mississippi Freedom Caucus Opposes AMA Childhood Genital Mutilation Policy |
---|---|---
| |
---
This week the Mississippi Freedom Caucus joined forces with state freedom caucuses across the nation to oppose the American Medical Association (AMA), the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), and the Children's Hospital Association (CHA) policy supporting childhood genital mutilation.

[Read More](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/Kkez7iC366GTXhX2QXDJmw)

body:
CVS accommodated her religious conviction for three-and-a-half years and didn’t require her to administer any life-ending drug
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zarbg7kb129c81d1145p2k1fifnrbsjjptm8o7so_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65thnmeobadlieeq33d5gssrm6pb5ccqj2p5jetjj8c74e2p3dd9hmao6coj0m3gefkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj32d5lmdjr4sj66lib6oj7m2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm6pb3cdh62p31c8iv0)

---
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4s7aikmra4v0sb9oaueojdmnja0r8ee3c4ij5u0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdhm4ob4c5h2bs)
---
Friend, This nurse practitioner's story deserves to go viral. It's a devastating example of what will continue to happen if we don't draw the line for freedom. [**_That 's why we're suing CVS_**** _._**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zd807enaagf3fscmcsn1hv05273p97msik179690_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdhm4ob4c5h2bs) But I'm getting ahead of myself. Paige Casey is a young nurse practitioner. For years, she faithfully served her community, working as a nurse practitioner at a local CVS MinuteClinic in Virginia. When she was hired, she made her employer aware that her Catholic faith prevented her from prescribing or dispensing abortion-inducing drugs._ _ CVS accommodated her religious conviction for three-and-a-half years and didn't require her to administer any life-ending drugs. But then in 2022, they told Paige they would no longer allow her religious freedom. A few months later, **_she was fired --just two days after earning a performance-based raise._** **This is blatant religious discrimination, and according to Virginia law -- it's illegal.**
---
| | [**SIGN THE PETITION**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfjvnuugqsemm1017icmseqd34a7d97f37soml50_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdhm4ob4c5h2bs)
---
With the ongoing effects still felt from the pandemic, health care workers are needed now more than ever. Forcing them to choose between violating their faith or being fired **_hurts everyone. _** **_And it 's downright un-American. _** Patients are best served by doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals who are free to act ethically and consistent with their beliefs. Despite having a spotless record, Paige is now _unemployed_ , simply because she stood for her faith. This unlawful discrimination cannot be allowed to stand. That's why Alliance Defending Freedom is filing a lawsuit against CVS on behalf of Paige. ADF is the world's largest legal organization committed to protecting religious freedom, free speech, marriage and family, parental rights, and the sanctity of life. We defend your most cherished liberties in Congress, state legislatures, and courtrooms across the country -- all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court if necessary. [**But we need your help. Will you help us send a strong message to CVS by signing our petition below?**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2za73d60rna7hf1fcl064g2ge4vh79cajdlc7i4vo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdhm4ob4c5h2bs) **_We the People, CVS customers, will not stand by and watch attacks on the religious rights of all Americans. _**
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zj924trnj2t4egr10csl5t9jm94t7bv4580eorfg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdhm4ob4c5h2bs)
---
Thank you in advance.
---
Michael Farris President and CEO Alliance Defending Freedom

---
Hi friend,
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52511956/372508359/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3677-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDZjNzhjYy1mOTRhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DiE79Ceivb-vWKRJtjqqFgephQlgYTfZYyTJMZt1uQg=)
I know you've heard from a lot of people about how Catherine Cortez Masto's (D-NV) Senate race is the most important in the country – but with just weeks until the election, I wanted you to hear it from me, too.
While you might associate me with my roles as an actor – particularly a former (fictional) president – I speak to you today as a concerned fellow American: **If Catherine Cortez Masto loses in Nevada, we hand over control of the Senate to Mitch McConnell, and worse still, pave the way for a second Trump era. **
[**I am going to do everything in my power to make sure that doesn't happen, which is why I'm emailing. Will you split a donation between Catherine’s campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's to keep the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52511957/372508360/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3677-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDZjNzhjYy1mOTRhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DiE79Ceivb-vWKRJtjqqFgephQlgYTfZYyTJMZt1uQg=)
You know as well as I do why we can't let that happen. The last time Republicans controlled our democratic institutions – headed by McConnell and the impeached former president – was marked by deception, selfishness and every hindrance of progress possible. This period culminated in an attack on democracy itself, sanctioned by many of those who could be part of the Senate majority if Sen. Cortez Masto loses this seat.
The darkness of those years should serve as a reminder for why our Democratic majority is so crucial – but the hopefulness of recent days should be our clarion call. Sen. Cortez Masto and her Democratic colleagues have helmed historic action on infrastructure, climate change, and lowering prescription drug prices. They confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court. And so much more.
**With hope and hard work, we've accomplished a great deal. But with Sen. Cortez Masto down 1 point in the polls and up against more than $50 million in GOP attacks, she _needs_ our help to win. **
[**Let's help Catherine raise $50,000 before her midnight fundraising deadline. Please split $5 between her campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's, or whatever you can spare, to save our Democratic majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52511958/372508361/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3677-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDZjNzhjYy1mOTRhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DiE79Ceivb-vWKRJtjqqFgephQlgYTfZYyTJMZt1uQg=)
I've been an activist most of my life, friend. I've witnessed our nation confront and overcome a host of consequential challenges. And I've learned that, at such critical junctures of history, we must ask ourselves: _Who do we want to be as a country_?
Do we want to be a country where the very right to bodily autonomy lies in the hands of right-wing extremists? The kind of country where health care and lifesaving medications are so expensive, they are out of reach for countless Americans? The kind of country where outright lies and conspiracies are used to tear down our democracy?
I say _no. No_ to the country that MAGA Republican rule would manifest. No to extremism and attacks on democracy and fundamental rights. **But – and I say this with no exaggeration – this all rides on whether Catherine Cortez Masto wins this battleground Senate race in Nevada.**
Experts from The New York Times to CNN are reporting Catherine is the most vulnerable Democratic senator on the ballot, so we urgently need to do our part to help her win. [**Will you please split a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare today, between Catherine’s campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's to help save our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52511959/372508362/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3677-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDZjNzhjYy1mOTRhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DiE79Ceivb-vWKRJtjqqFgephQlgYTfZYyTJMZt1uQg=)
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

| | | **Uncle Tom...

You ain’t black...**
Friend, these are just a few of the things I’ve been called because I’m a black conservative, but in all honesty, these aren’t even the worst ones...

Democrats and the liberal media refuse to believe that racial minorities like me can think for ourselves. To be frank: they think they own us.

When they see a person of color who doesn’t accept the liberal narrative, they go after them harder than anyone else.

**Make no mistake, I face constant attacks from the left day in and day out, and I’m not the only one. **

But the worst thing? Democrats are winning.
Democrats are surging in the polls and _**millions of voters across the country have begun early voting.**_

Fellow Conservative:

Joe Biden's FBI? Lying? Well, of course, they are!

They lied about Russiagate. They lied about targeting moms and dads protesting at school boards. They lied about Hunter Biden's laptop. Lying is what they do.
So when the FBI announced that violent crime fell 1% last year, most Americans were skeptical. They had good reason to be.
It turns out that the FBI's report left out crime stats from 40% of the nation's law enforcement agencies, including in New York and Los Angeles's woke free-fire zones.
The Biden Administration knows the national crime wave was "Made in DC" by the Democratic Party, George Soros, and woke Twitter mobs. They know the violence on our streets and along our borders is their doing. They don't care. They think the crime wave is a job well done.
We must take back our streets and communities by taking control of Congress with true conservative leaders!
Help strengthen the House Freedom Caucus now!
In California, shoplifting has effectively been legalized. Manhattan's district attorney refuses to seek prison time for drug dealing or even armed robbery. In Chicago, car theft is up 700%, but the woke DA is dropping the charges of 30% of all felony defendants!
If this were my record, I wouldn't want the FBI to report on it either!
The Biden Crime Wave is a national disgrace.
Help end the Left's crime wave by electing Freedom Caucus conservatives in the November elections.

You can donate directly to them through HFF, and 100% of your contributions go directly to their campaigns.
Support these candidates with a split contribution today!
Only a conservative majority in the House of Representatives can do the job. The solutions are right there:
✓ Seal the border.✓ Defund sanctuary cities.✓ End federal aid to states that Defund the Police.✓ End federal aid to cities with Soros-backed woke prosecutors.✓ Reform the FBI, so it goes back to fighting crime.✓ Make dealing fentanyl a capital offense.
The sources of the Biden Crime Wave are not poverty or hopelessness. They are woke politicians and prosecutors who side with criminals against the innocent people they victimize.
A conservative House majority can finally take the fight to the criminals and the corrupt liberals coddling them.
But we need your help.
You see, the Republican establishment in Washington does not want courageous conservatives in Congress. They want more RINOs who will continue business as usual. We can't allow that to happen.
Help elect true conservative fighters and end Biden's crime wave.
Give as generously as you can and help take back our streets and our country!
The November elections are coming soon, so there's no time to waste. Let's work together to make this a tidal wave election that cleans out the Swamp and puts America back on track.
Thank you for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help fight for our country's future.

Sincerely,

Ray Yonkura

body:
That should disqualify anyone from public office, but no, instead, Tina Kotek wants a promotion.
[](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-r/) **_I 'm a mom, _**_and I will always stand by our kids, our teachers, and our schools to ensure our kids receive the best education we can provide. _[__**Not Tina Kotek.**__](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-j/)_Instead of defending parents, instead of defending our kids -and instead of ensuring our schools stayed open during the pandemic-**Tina Kotek did everything but that -keeping our schools closed longer than anywhere else in the nation.** That did detrimental harm to our kids, and last month's state test results prove it._ [](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-t/) [RUSH $27 | PUT A MOM IN CHARGE 👩](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-i/) [RUSH $27 | 🥾 KICK TINA OUT OF THE CLASSROOM](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-d/) _Even with record funding for our public education system,_ Oregon's high school graduation rate remains one of the _**[worst in the nation](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-h/)**_. Student achievement rates, too, continually _**[lag behind](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-k/)**_ the national average. ...and by keeping our schools closed longer than anywhere else in the nation, _**Tina Kotek threw our kids under the bus.**__That should disqualify anyone from public office, but no,**instead, Tina Kotek wants a promotion.**_ [RUSH $27 | PUT A MOM IN CHARGE 👩](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-u/) [RUSH $27 | 🥾 KICK TINA OUT OF THE CLASSROOM](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-o/) Our kids deserve so much better, but the current system puts the interests of bureaucrats and their misguided priorities ahead of student learning. _They 're too focused on __**[teaching kindergartners progressive](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-b/)** political agendas rather than how to read, write, and do math. It has to end._Our kids don't need more of the same failed leadership, they need a new direction. _**As Governor, I am committed to getting parents back in and politics out of our classrooms.**_ [RUSH $27 | PUT A MOM IN CHARGE 👩](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-n/) [RUSH $27 | 🥾 KICK TINA OUT OF THE CLASSROOM](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-p/) [__**Your support here and now is CRITICAL to making that a reality -and to kicking Tina Kotek out of the classroom.**__](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-x/) _We 're twenty-seven days from Election Day-and ballots are set to drop any day now!_ _**Since Oregon is 100% vote-by-mail, our election is GUARANTEED to be decided well before November 8th -**_[_**_meaning I need your support NOW! _**_](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-m/)_If every Oregonian ready to put our kids first -instead of dangerous special interests-_[__**gave just $27**__](https://christinedrazanforgovernoror.cmail20.com/t/y-l-ntltyx-iukrjimdh-c/)** _, we 'll not only maintain but EXPAND our narrow lead in this race._** This race will come down to turnout, and every bit of support matters-_especially when National Democrats are throwing MILLIONS behind Tina Kotek to save her capsizing campaign._[__**Would you answer my call-to-action and give $27 to help me stay ahead of Tina? | | | Peter - This is Dr. Oz.

I've given out a lot of advice on skincare over my long career. But now I'm asking you to put some skin in the game.

Traveling across Pennsylvania, I've heard from thousands of Americans about the daily struggles they face in the Biden era. I'm hearing one thing loud and clear: _addressing those challenges is at the very bottom of Biden 's to-do list._

Instead of focusing on the price of gas, food, and other essentials, Biden and the Democrats are far more concerned about transgender athletes and the Green New Deal.

**NOW** , we're hearing that my leftist opponent, John Fetterman, thinks the administration hasn't gone far enough!

We can't allow John Fetterman to double down on Biden's failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism. That's why I'm coming to you for help.

Ron DeSantis is America's Governor...

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osxHiHXhNQ

RUSH IN
YOUR SUPPORT TO RE-ELECT GOVERNOR RON DESANTIS!

Friend,

Ron
DeSantis is America's Governor.

He leads
with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is
dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the
state he's called home since his birth.

Ron
worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball
and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in
History.

After
graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he
volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on
active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy
SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the
Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal

I met Ron
while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in
Northeast Florida.

While on
his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office
and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to
convict child predators.

Ron and I
were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.

Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning
a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of
three terms in Congress.

While in
office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a
balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts
to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in
abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia
collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was
also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact
reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016,
Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood.
>From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever
changed our lives.

Shortly
after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018
was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was
elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son
Mason to the world.

In 2020,
we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie.
She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50
years.

I've
watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S.
Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our
three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.

As a
father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the
classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children -
so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit
mandates and empower parents. Rush in your support to help us
keep fighting >>>

He
foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a
result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of
Florida open for business.

As a
federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding
the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law
enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from
the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida
is a law-and-order state.

But if
you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed
with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the
dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to
pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He
was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to
fight for myself. That is who Ron DeSantis is.

He
accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our
fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are
turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue
states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than
their own citizens. They're fighting to take away parents' rights
in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that
indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron's
opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the
time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine
mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police,
and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies.

I can
tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to
stay in the fight.

Will you
join us in the fight today by sending your support for my
husband's re-election? >>>

SUPPORT
GOVERNOR DESANTIS >>>

KEEP
FLORIDA FREE >>>

RUSH IN
YOUR SUPPORT >>>

Sincerely,
Casey
DeSantis

MAKE A
DONATION

Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor

body:

Friend,

My dad used to wake me up at 6 a.m. each morning and say, "Put your shoes on, son. Get ready. There's something for you to do."
He was many things throughout his life: a veteran, a small businessman, and a preacher. He spent his days fixing junk cars that other folks had discarded – and then on Sundays, he preached to folks who felt discarded.
One of my last memories of my dad was calling him the day Barack Obama was inaugurated as the 44th president of the United States. I heard the pride and joy in his voice – the ways in which he saw the arc of history bending a little closer toward justice. Two years later, my dad was gone. As the senior pastor at Dr. King's church, I had the sad duty and honor of eulogizing him.

My father taught me so much – from the meaning of hard work to the value of serving others – and I bring these lessons with me wherever I go, including to the U.S. Senate. He's a big reason why I'm in this fight to build a better, brighter future for all people, not just the lucky few.
**But keeping up this fight in Washington won't be easy:_NPR_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection – in a race that experts say could decide Senate control. The only way I can fight back and defend my critical seat is if folks like you chip in now. **

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | Hey folks, We all know that these midterms are _close_ , and that if Democrats don’t turn out, we’re at serious risk of a GOP-controlled Congress. But in spite of those doubts, we know that the majority of Haley’s supporters are still very confident that she can win this seat in November. Folks – I have counted on people like you to fuel my campaign in this incredibly important battleground race, and it’s thanks to your support that we’ve made it this far. [**I hope I can continue to count on your support through Election Day – if you can, please chip in a gift of $3 now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52508003/372492123/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1857-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA3YjhhMi1lZTRhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rzUimIKWPPI7t_oKWmN-mi3yjQ_1-QJ3gMcz8sLyomg=) But today, I am reaching out to you, my supporters, to tell you a little about my first supporters: my wonderful parents.
I count myself incredibly lucky to have had parents like Peggy and Bob Wood. On top of being kind, generous, and loving parents, both were incredible role models who showed me and my siblings what living a life of purpose looks like.
I was named after my mom, Margaret “Peggy” Wood. And her name was not the only thing she passed down to me. Throughout her life, she made it a point to get involved in the issues that mattered to her. She knocked doors for candidates she cared about, donated when she could, and even served on the state board of the local Planned Parenthood.
Her work on behalf of women is something that I carry with me to this day and serves as a constant reminder of how hard women fought to secure their fundamental freedoms (_and why we can’t go back_).

My father, Bob, also fought – more literally – for what he believed in. Having fought against tyranny abroad in WWII, he was passionate about instilling the importance of freedom in his children.
I see my life in public service as an answer to the breakfast table question he used to ask me and my siblings: “what are you doing for freedom today?” He knew that even in the world’s greatest democracy, the fight for freedom was a daily one. And that continues to be true. It’s something that I take extremely seriously – and that feels especially urgent as I face election-denier Don Bolduc in one of the toughest races of my life.
**[But I’ve never been one to run from a challenge. Not when the stakes are this high and when my values are on the line – it’s just not how I was raised. That’s why I’m here, right now, asking for your support, everyone.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52508004/372492124/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1857-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA3YjhhMi1lZTRhLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rzUimIKWPPI7t_oKWmN-mi3yjQ_1-QJ3gMcz8sLyomg=)**

The relentless attacks on our democratic process and institutions must be met with forceful and unrelenting opposition. We need people to speak out, we need people to volunteer to be poll workers, to march in the streets and organize their communities, and yes, to [**_donate_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52507879/372491908/-982003667?amount=30&refcode=20221013.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk0MDdiOGEyLWVlNGEtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VY3t4umVeadX5QgoZH92wTVj6MAsAUsW7FISRCE0pt4=) to help organizations like ours fight on every front.

The NDRC is all-in. In addition to supporting our slate of over 400 Democracy Defenders, we’re working in 17 states where strategic investments can make the difference between fair elections and minority rule. subject: Our Story
body:
| | | [](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=30e3dc1f58&e=fdefed58de)
---
Peter,Ron DeSantis is America’s Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he’s called home since his birth.
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=c5a4cdc4d3&e=fdefed58de)
Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.

[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=3ef824588b&e=fdefed58de)
After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=51b341f13c&e=fdefed58de)
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney’s Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=0dfb4c5744&e=fdefed58de)
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet – parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=1fca24e7c0&e=fdefed58de)
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I’ve watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=862d923393&e=fdefed58de)
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children – so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. [**Rush in your support to help us keep fighting >>>**](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=36f3faf96e&e=fdefed58de)

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn’t. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn’t have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=33dd2f4f1a&e=fdefed58de)
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They’re fighting to take away parents’ rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron’s opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He’s made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians – including children – defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left’s woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

_[**Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband’s re-election? >>>**](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=54c0f43835&e=fdefed58de)_
[](https://winred.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=cd956fa32c&e=fdefed58de)
Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis

Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida. While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney’s Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators. Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress. While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health. In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet – parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives. Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world. In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years. I’ve watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding. As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children – so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business. As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state. But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn’t. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn’t have the strength to fight for myself. That is who Ron DeSantis is. He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands. Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They’re fighting to take away parents’ rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children. Ron’s opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He’s made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians – including children – defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left’s woke ideologies. I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight. Sincerely, Casey DeSantis | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Tenney for Congress. All rights reserved.

name: John Grisham
subject: Cheri will fight to level the playing field.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Cheri would provide one of the most important and impactful voices in Washington.
#

Hey there,
It’s John Grisham, reaching out on behalf of the woman I hope we will elect as North Carolina’s next Senator: Cheri Beasley. Can you give me a moment to explain why her race is so important and what her leadership in the Senate would mean for our families?
I spend a lot of time thinking and writing about justice in this country — and how often it is out of reach for working people, particularly in poor communities and communities of color.
Today, stories like mine are a lot harder to come by. I was born and raised in the deep south. We didn’t have much. My parents didn’t have a formal education, but they worked hard to make sure we had enough and gave us every opportunity they could to thrive.
Too many families struggle to get ahead, and for a lot of folks, the opportunities I got were always out of reach. The status quo has always been and remains tilted in favor of the wealthy and well-connected, and it’s no accident.
Cheri Beasley understands that it’s time to level the playing field for working families, and that’s what she will do as North Carolina’s next Senator. But first, she needs our help to win this race.
[**Will you please donate anything you can to her campaign today? Corporate special interests are spending over $34 million attacking her to buy this seat, and we need to make sure they cannot drown her out with dark money.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221013-1-subs&t=1&akid=2007%2E357359%2ElBvrgV)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221013-1-subs&t=2&akid=2007%2E357359%2ElBvrgV)**
North Carolina and Cheri’s campaign are personally important to me. My wife was born in Raleigh, and my family is full of Tar Heels. I know that this state deserves a leader like Cheri representing them in the U.S. Senate, and for all of us, flipping this seat is one of our best chances to move the needle toward justice in this country.
Cheri would provide one of the most important and impactful voices in Washington. She is undeniably qualified with her wealth of experience as a public defender, judge, and Chief Justice of North Carolina’s Supreme Court. She will also bring an important perspective to the Senate Chamber that currently has zero African American women serving.
I know we can trust her to stand up to the special interests that thrive off of Washington gridlock and corruption.
But we cannot expect our broken system to fix itself. We have to fight for it. So I am asking:
[**Please consider making a contribution to Cheri’s campaign today to win North Carolina. Early voting starts in 7 days, and it’s going to take a lot of us chipping in what we can to take on the corrupt interests trying to buy this seat.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221013-1-subs&t=3&akid=2007%2E357359%2ElBvrgV)
