name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkr6n9hmdpn745tcstdk0jjqrq7mj0e43e6iq5d8_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znqgrpfndjoeg96fajjl87atfgdtrg97kpdad2bg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn6scomarbcuf59r4ektibvlkb5d82qr1tqkpq4o_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zckbtghvnab860ja762tk8a7vlnlgvg25v9ie63o_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znb80hnemjp8ku4ncdbtabnpgr74qjc2qna4ilgg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zc48sfs9fjonag9dt3tnn7m5e0l9subtmnch9c58_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5rmo6jl2f86u0idha0a01q10idehfi5c63v25fo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0vlhhijvb2eijhnq8b2qm8m21j11jamokdmj3c0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn7jvf9ludda6mijtidvju4169d1k8lh4i069keo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zui7en1a8cdhgrj0i59f60vheeg6nohpg8je4ceg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb836jbfc760kqh86op0fgvfr104tq3kqcd71atg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8l3s21ip6qc9qj12an6tg0k6p54l6d8d5p6oucg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ziqb80bap398fd1hp8esdd0t7r3pim9b47f8mspg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1ggef4o3v3alnnt2mrjn30gcqveb7g0ermku2go_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z94jdcffbhetbhi5n6p06qb3pp17eu0c5psrm59g_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8sikjm3b07b9v7g7n24n9jl6hjs4i3n3d3e3820_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhcskio0lpoiubk4vtpsj2d4ea5p548e7733ssro_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5059u01nltc3he8k474f27bjgnphem8ebutvth8_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge4oj2c5h2bs "Step up now!")**_

---

body:
| | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us14.campaign-archive.com/?e=2fa613cb76&u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=ba031e7e15)
---
| | |
---
| _**Regan Deering for Congress**_
---
| | |
---
| **Friends,**
**I am honored to be endorsed by the Fraternal Order of the Police, but more importantly, I am grateful for their service. ** **In order to protect and serve our community, law enforcement needs support from our elected officials.** ** ** **The “Defund the Police” movement and policies supported by my opponent have helped hollow out police departments across our state with officers leaving the profession in record numbers.** ** ** **Our law enforcement is working overtime \- being away from their families to protect ours. ** ** ** **They are working overtime running toward trouble, so we can run away from it. ** ** ** **They are working overtime to help bring peace and justice for all.** ** ** **Supporting the police can’t just be lip service or political ads for our elected officials.** ** ** **That support comes in many ways, including funding, training, and coordination.** ** ** **We need elected officials who understand their value, risk and dedication.** ** ** **Supporting the police means voting for laws to help them and against laws to hurt them. ** ** ** **It also means ensuring that they don’t just have a seat at the table - but influence in the outcome of the discussion. ** ** ** **Two years ago my opponent helped pass criminal justice reform that was opposed by nearly every law enforcement group in the state. ** ** ** **That doesn’t sound like justice to me. ** ** ** **I will listen to these experts when they give me their opinions, and use their counsel to make my decisions. ** ** ** **I will vote to refund their departments instead of for massive unfunded mandates that burden them with costs and regulations. ** ** ** **I will vote for policies to help them secure our schools to ensure that they can more safely and efficiently protect our children in cases of emergency.** ** ** **I will help protect their qualified immunity so they can continue to save lives and livelihoods. ** ** ** **Most of all, I will vote for policies that help handcuff criminals - not the police. ** ** ** **I want you all to know that you don’t just have my votes - you also have my voice. ** ** ** **As your Congresswoman, I will fight against the anti-police narrative that is currently being told here in Illinois and around the country. ** ** ** **I am endorsed because these brave officers see potential and commitment in me to be that representative - their representative.** ** ** **Thank you to the ILFOP for standing with me and please know that I will ALWAYS stand with our law enforcement officers.**
---

Thank you,
Regan Deering
Republican Candidate for Congress, IL13**

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What I’m hearing about choice in my district
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221013&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221013&amount=28]
Friend,
I’ve heard more about choice from the folks in my district in the last four months than the last four years. I’ve heard how this is a violation of personal freedom, how there are little girls growing up in a world with fewer rights than their mothers and grandmothers, but what I’ve mostly heard are stories.
Since the repeal of Roe v. Wade I’ve had women quietly approach me – some have literally whispered in my ear – to tell me their personal stories. Stories of abortions, of miscarriages, of health complications, and of the fear and desperation that comes with making such a personal choice in a world where the government is dictating what choices are available to us. Today, I want to share some of those stories with you.
I’ve had multiple older women approach me, to describe their experience of life before Roe. Some recalled being a teenager – fearing for their safety and knowing that they would have no place to live if their family found out. Others told me about the extreme psychological consequences of a rape that resulted in pregnancy, and how they would have been completely unable to care for a child. Their stories were different, but what they all had in common was the experience of seeking out and obtaining an abortion at a time when it was not legal, regulated, or guarenteed to be safe. They were all distraught that we could go back to the time they had lived through.
Others have told me about their faith. I’ve heard from women who could never personally choose to get an abortion due to their faith, but who in the same breath say they have never walked in another woman’s shoes and wouldn’t tell her how to live. Devout Catholics and Christians, who attend church every Sunday, have told me that they are deeply pro-life, but that there is nothing in life with no exceptions and that their faith teaches them not to judge others.
I’ve heard from women, both pro-choice and pro-life, who desperately wanted a child but suffered a miscarriage and needed procedures like a D&C that are techincally considered abortions. Women who had ectopic pregnancies that needed an abortion to save their lives and others who, if not treated, may have lost the ability to have children altogether. Some have told me that they’ve made the decision with their spouse to not have any more children – despite wanting to – because of past pregnancy complications, and the fear that medical treatment may not be available if they have complications in the future.
People of every political affiliation have expressed that this will not affect all women equally. That many people can’t just take four or five days off of work to travel to Canada or another state – much less afford the lodging and the transportation. They’ve also commented on how there are no new requirements for men.
Two weeks ago, I was invited by a Republican women's group in Brighton to come and talk just about this issue. Women only in the basement of one of their homes. There were 25 women, many who view themselves as pro-life, who wanted to understand what was fact and fiction. I think when women get together, we know instinctively that there are a million reasons why you may desperately want a child but can't carry one to term.
I’ll leave you with this story. It’s not one that was personally told to me, but that I heard on NPR while I was in my car ( you can read the full article here [https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2022/07/26/1111280165/because-of-texas-abortion-law-her-wanted-pregnancy-became-a-medical-nightmare] ). A woman in Texas – in the middle of a miscarriage – was told at the hospital to go home because her fever wasn’t high enough and she wasn’t bleeding hard enough. Because of the new Texas law, she was sent home – repeatedly – to have her miscarriage on her own. Finally, a panel of doctors determined it was okay for her to have the procedure she needed. Think about that.
That’s not something I’m willing to let happen in my state – I will be fighting to ensure Michigan women continue to have the freedom to make this incredibly personal choice without the government in the room.

I really don't reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important. I'll be short, though.

Here are the facts:
1. Marco Rubio has been outraised Five Quarters in a row.
2. Marco's opponent, Val Demings, is financially backed by Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer.
3. Poll after poll after poll shows his race is tied.
4. The media is saying Marco's in the fight of his career, and he's never seen a race as tough as this.
5. His opponent has spent over $47 million spreading lies about him, and Marco can't keep up.
6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

---

**[If you can spare $16, $24, or even $45, it will make all the difference in this tied race.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61628010:6pxvSUVN7:m:1:3317145305:6220488FF2A7534F4C85846CE266F062:r "If you can spare

| | | [LET'S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER >>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61628010:6pxvSUVN7:m:1:3317145305:6220488FF2A7534F4C85846CE266F062:r "LET’S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER >>")
---
Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that's tied. If you're staying on the sidelines because you think you don't matter, that's just not true!

__You__ have the power to decide what happens next. __You have two choices__ :
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can't get our country back on track.
2. **[We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61628011:6pxvSUVN7:m:1:3317145305:6220488FF2A7534F4C85846CE266F062:r "We can work
together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats").**

---

---
If you don't donate because you think it doesn't matter, I really hope you reconsider. If you can't donate because you can't afford to, know that I understand, and I appreciate you taking the time to read this.

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson

I'm starting to get nervous because I am one of the most vulnerable Republicans up for re-election this November and Pelosi knows that if the Dems defeat me, they will have full access to pass their liberal agenda.

**The Filibuster will be abolished.

Speech will be censored.**

**And conservatives will be silenced.**

I just don't know what to do. I keep asking myself, _" Is it even worth reaching out to them again?"_

I know you get a lot of these, and I know it can be overwhelming looking at all the requests. But if you respond to just 1 today, please, make it this one. I am being outraised 3 to 1, and polls are tied. They're saying this may be my closest race yet. **They 're saying I'm in the fight of my life.**

I’m watching it too, and I have to say, I’m outraged at the thought that someone who supported all these lies, all this violence might be the next person to represent Wisconsin’s 3rd district, flipping Rep. Ron Kind’s seat red. Frankly, team, I’m mad.
It’s untenable to think that we could send someone who attacked our Capitol with no regard for our history or our Republic.

name: Joe Kent
subject: Guess who just endorsed me?
body:
Dear Supporter,
I have big news.
You may have heard of Tulsi Gabbard. She was the vice-chair of the Democrat National Committee and a Democrat U.S. Congresswoman but she left the Democrat party because it has become, in her words:
"Hostile to people of faith and spirituality, demonizes the police and protects criminals at the expense of law-abiding Americans, believes in open borders, weaponizes the national security state to go after political opponents, and above all, drags us ever closer to nuclear war."
**And yesterday, she endorsed my campaign for Congress.**
Watch the video of her endorsement here: [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Tulsi](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/j8nD7W2n3UjQ8Se5MzB8BA/Mb7fDpxRmoVQ4lZhlcaOQw).
Will you join Tulsi in saying ENOUGH to the extremists running the Democrat party by making a contribution to my campaign at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/JdylJCv763b6OQ9ADtQLjrrQ/Mb7fDpxRmoVQ4lZhlcaOQw)?
From the beginning, my campaign and my message has been about more than pitting one party against another. It's been about putting America and our people first.
And yet my opponent in this race is more passionate and committed to defending the borders of Ukraine than she is protecting our own borders. She wants to prevent Americans from purchasing the same firearms she herself owns. She has endorsed higher taxes on energy production here at home.
**And worst of all, she would keep Nancy Pelosi in charge of Congress.**
We can't let her win. Please help me with a donation to my campaign today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/JdylJCv763b6OQ9ADtQLjrrQ/Mb7fDpxRmoVQ4lZhlcaOQw).
Thank you.
Joe Kent

body:

What if I told you that my opponent is a “hardcore-MAGA” extremist who backed a national abortion ban?

When Democrats are backed into a corner, they lie. Every single time.

When polling started to show Republican Georgia Senate nominee Herschel Walker pulling away with the pivotal Georgia Senate race, Democrat operatives knew that they had to do something to blunt his momentum. body:
First, our work saves lives. Whether it’s because of legislation passed in the states or in Congress, there are unquestionably people alive today because of our work.
#

Friends -
We send a lot of fundraising emails, no doubt about it. We hope you’ll take that not as a nuisance, but as a sign of just how important these messages are to the cause of making our communities safer from gun violence.
Let us explain:
First, our work saves lives. Whether it’s because of legislation passed in the states or in Congress, there are unquestionably people alive today because of our work.
Now what you may not know is that the vast majority of the donations Giffords receives comes from lots of people chipping in small amounts of money.
Since we launched, we’ve received almost 1 million individual online donations, at an average gift of around just $30.
And there is no greater single source of those donations than emails like this one.
That’s why we ask.
And with the election just weeks away, this is such a critical moment in time for our work and for the future of this issue. So we are once again asking for your financial support:

Can we count on you?

We have so many important ways for you to help. Check out all our volunteer needs below. But first, I have a really important event I want to highlight. We are hosting a live, toll-free telephone town hall to update our most loyal advocates!

This event will occur TONIGHT at 7 pm Central Time. You can call the event from anywhere by dialing 855-962-1493. We will discuss our current strategy as we face down Walz’s dangerous and radical machine and how you can help. Again to participate, dial in using this number 855-962-1493.

_**PHONE BANKING**_

Our next phone banking opportunity is on Saturday. _Will you join us?_

Make sure to bring your own device. You can bring a laptop, iPad, tablet or smart phone. Also, headphones will really help. To schedule a shift, fill out the form below with all the times you are available.

subject: Will we see Max Miller in today's hearing?
body:

---
Peter, The January 6 hearings are detailing how Donald Trump and his enablers organized an angry mob to attack our Congress because they wanted to keep power. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622055:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622056:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622056:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622056:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622057:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622058:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61622058:6uls0UVsN:m:1:3368395361:8E9F88F7DB5ABF38E55B104B6306E15B:r "Step up
now!")**_

---

---

I loved my community, but I learned early on our society had deep issues. My school didn't have walls or a roof, so when it rained, we couldn't go to school. And there wasn't a doctor within fifty miles. Like so many who come to America, I wanted a better life. It was especially important for me to raise my children in a place that valued freedom and the equality of every person -- free of the strict rules I had to abide by as a kid. After earning my medical degree in 1991, I immigrated to Lexington, Kentucky to pursue a career in medicine. I have a deep appreciation for the freedoms and opportunities provided in this country -- and not a day goes by that I don’t work to give back. In addition to my medical practice, I have played leading roles with organizations like **UNICEF** and the **Valley Rescue Mission** to eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness across Southern California. And if any patient comes to my practice without insurance, we don’t ask for payment. **I'm running for Congress because everything that made the United States the _"City upon a Hill"_ I immigrated to is crumbling in front of us. Our rights and freedoms are being picked apart by radicals. Here in Orange County, extremism and outright racism are at all-time highs. ** Our district is home to one of the largest Asian communities in the country, yet our incumbent Congresswoman Young Kim refuses to speak out against the spike in anti-Asian hate incidents we’ve faced. Friend, we can't expect to uphold and protect our values as Americans when politicians make their careers by sowing hate and division. On top of all that, families are being financially squeezed from every direction. Women are losing their freedom over their own bodies. Many are worrying about what’s next, and that’s a trend in the wrong direction. I refuse to sit on the sidelines -- not with our children's future at stake. That’s why I’m in this race and asking for your support: [**I know we can win this race, but it will take a lot of grassroots support from our community and beyond. Derek, there are 26 days to go until this November’s election. **26****days.** We have to make every one of these days count because this election will determine the future of our country. clean_body: We passed the Inflation Reduction Act to lower energy costs, health care costs, and prescription drug costs. | | Derek, there are 26 days to go until this November’s election. 26days. We have to make every one of these days count because this election will determine the future of our country. This year, the stakes could not be higher. Now, I know we say that every election cycle, but what is at stake this year in these midterms is so apparent -- everything from voting rights to abortion is on the ballot. If we defend the seats we need to hold on to our majority in the House and we protect --or better yet, expand \-- our majority in the Senate, we can continue our progress. You haven’t made a donation yet this year. Can I count on you to make your first gift of the year? We passed the Inflation Reduction Act to lower energy costs, health care costs, and prescription drug costs. Democrats have proven that when the people put our party in charge, we know how to deliver results. From now until November 8, it is up to all of us to build on our momentum, including you. Ensuring the DNC meets its deadlines is critical to getting Democrats up and down the ballot across the finish line, so I’m asking: Thank you for doing what you can to support Democrats, Derek. Folks — Michael’s campaign is powered by tens of thousands of hardworking people, and almost all of them live and work right here in Colorado. But for those of you supporting from afar, there are some things you should know about our state:
1. **A “fourteener” is a special Colorado bragging right.** Even if you’ve grown up at 5280 or above, getting to the top of a 14,000 foot high mountain is hard — and an achievement worth posting about.

2. **We’re proud of our peaches — and our chiles.** Forget Georgia; Colorado’s Palisade peaches are the sweetest in the USA. And our Pueblo green chiles put any other state’s to shame (don’t let New Mexico tell you different).

3. **Everybody votes by mail, so we “get out the vote” for weeks.** In CO, every registered voter automatically receives a ballot in mid-October. It’s great for ballot access — we have the second highest voter turnout in the country, after all — but that’s an added challenge for campaigns like ours. We need to keep our closing message in front of voters for weeks, not days.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61620198:68mksOVN_:m:1:3364136623:F8B4D256BF7D026B1158CD383105D9B3:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61620198:68mksOVN_:m:1:3364136623:F8B4D256BF7D026B1158CD383105D9B3:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61620198:68mksOVN_:m:1:3364136623:F8B4D256BF7D026B1158CD383105D9B3:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61620198:68mksOVN_:m:1:3364136623:F8B4D256BF7D026B1158CD383105D9B3:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,

Thank you!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61620198:68mksOVN_:m:1:3364136623:F8B4D256BF7D026B1158CD383105D9B3:r) **

subject: Our Story
body:
Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental heal
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zo4f57gsi4lml640ppfpihgsp7op3hnks5b9bd30_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij79hnmer7acjjegon9crl6crn2ct66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u4qe7cpj69gr4p36csq30obkcmpn6s5hclrm2otgcthrepjje4q6apj3c1oj4dtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6iqr6ptnc5j7ao5jcgrr1db5e8iv0)
**[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpmji4v5n0nr81l0ro1rc170h9bcevhlq6rhpf4o_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)**

Friend,

Ron DeSantis is America's Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he's called home since his birth.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zn11tlvb7v1dg9lpefn90aqmjtf93sa1e31s9nv0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0dbjr9nqbr3b4urn4lf8ggiufp752auk4vigs9g_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5ooq2il3cp80t31g95hg2149dtrueusqluls83g_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsjp09aetp6o6vef04edn7a6lfqccjg5jfm3l8po_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zuci7dtqi8krj418b1mt0tv71ddfj2jdir731nqo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I've watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4fkvbccphfvbvf3lu4qo2fjta4ehr1nbj79nje0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children - so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. **[Rush in your support to help us keep fighting>>>](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ztfqd8dg6b4fmdqcr0e1cfjq6vpv5o4fgmd7kop0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs "Rush in your support to help us keep fighting")**

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zel2qgpmt2fas6ejekoea41op0eb2a0uvrof7cfo_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs)
---

He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They're fighting to take away parents' rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron's opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

__**[Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband's re-election?](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zc3j7hb9hl2e3rres1u2gss2pnsv82kfd9me5s4g_rp22sh2s8i66or5cdge9ob2clh2bs "Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband’s re-election?")**__

Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis

**Time is of the essence, so we’ll keep this short.**
**Voter registration deadlines are quickly approaching.** At this point, you’re probably registered to vote and ready to cast your ballot (after all, we’ve been reminding you for months). Not sure if your registration is up to date?
**[Take two minutes to check your registration today!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52559416/372631079/170341202?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTRkMzBhMy0zMTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qXcBIDDtkEcVAYAQDVvix_A9z7D0vbgGnLz9Poagst0=&emci=425cb0c4-7a4a-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=5e4d30a3-314b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)**

**Let’s be clear: Our days to register are numbered, but our power is limitless. **
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52559417/372631080/1097869781?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTRkMzBhMy0zMTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qXcBIDDtkEcVAYAQDVvix_A9z7D0vbgGnLz9Poagst0=&emci=425cb0c4-7a4a-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=5e4d30a3-314b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52559418/372631081/1097869781?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTRkMzBhMy0zMTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qXcBIDDtkEcVAYAQDVvix_A9z7D0vbgGnLz9Poagst0=&emci=425cb0c4-7a4a-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=5e4d30a3-314b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)

But right now, we have a Republican nominee for Secretary of State in Nevada, Jim Marchant, who is willing to throw that all out the door and has promised to NOT certify election results when the GOP loses. He’s a dangerous election denier, a conspiracy theorist, and a key leader of Trump’s America First Secretary of State Coalition.
Picture this: it’s the 2024 presidential election and Donald Trump is losing by a few thousands votes in Nevada and refusing to concede. Marchant has promised to do everything in his power to throw out the results - and ensure Trump wins.
And it’s not just Nevada. In states from Arizona to Michigan, MAGA election deniers are vying to become the TOP election officials who will carry out radical plans to overturn the results of a free and fair election.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

When a U.S. Senator is elected, they’re given a term of six years. That’s
a long time.

So it’s not too much to ask that at least once during those six years,
they show up to defend their record and explain to their constituents why
they deserve another six-year term.

That’s why I was so surprised when Rand Paul refused to show up for our
debate last week. I had to debate against an empty chair.

The people of Kentucky deserve a Senator who wants to represent them --
not someone who rarely shows up in Kentucky and only has one office in the
entire Commonwealth.

I’m running to be a Senator who actually represents Kentucky. And I know I
can win. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18746?t=1001&akid=2595%2E346206%2EjHvcqe ]But I need your help to make it happen. Please pitch in $20 or

name: Christina Cammon
subject: the Senate needs my mom in it

| | | I know that she has the resilience and compassion to lead our country and our state to brighter, kinder days. | | | |
---
Peter, growing up, my mom taught my siblings and me that we needed to do only one thing to make her proud: live a life of purpose and service.
My mom never pushed us to join a million extracurriculars or become lawyers.**But she always made sure that we moved throughout our lives with kindness and a clear sense of right and wrong.** She wanted us to be good friends, respectful students, kind neighbors, and openhearted community members – committed to improving the lives of others.
My mom made sure to let us know when we inevitably fell short – when we forgot to practice empathy or we acted selfishly. **But more than anything else, she instilled those values in us by living them out herself, every day.**
You see, my mom has always been drawn to service and community. As a kid, she was a devoted candy striper, volunteering in local hospitals. As a young woman, she was a diligent nursing student and loving mom. As a new widow, she became a hospice nurse and channeled her grief into action, helping families weather the same pain she still felt every day.
**And now, she is going to bring that same dedication to service and to purpose to the halls of Congress.**
With all the division and hatred in our politics these days, the Senate needs a nurse's mind and a nurse's heart. **_But even more than that, the Senate needs my mom's mind and heart._** I've seen her lead our family and others through some of their darkest moments. I know that she has the resilience and compassion to lead our country and our state to brighter, kinder days.
**But my mom's election is just over three weeks away, and to win, she's counting on folks like you to stand with her.[That's why I'm personally asking you, Peter: Will you make a donation – any amount that you can spare helps – to fund my mom's campaign in these final weeks? With less than 4 weeks until Election Day, we can’t afford to waste any time. Congressional Republicans are doing everything in their power (and spending every dollar they earn) to do irreparable damage to the American people, and we can’t stand by and let it happen.

Maintaining our momentum is crucial, but with a really slow start to fundraising this month, we’re not in the best position to keep things going the way we’d hoped. We have to play catch up. Otherwise, we risk giving Republicans a sizable lead and putting Lisa’s seat in jeopardy. | | |
---
Friend, this latest news has me worried:
**My GOP opponent, Herschel Walker, just announced that he's raised more than $30 MILLION to defeat me and take back the Senate for Republicans.**
**To make things worse, we just fell short of yesterday's fundraising goal, right as Walker and the GOP establishment are blanketing the airwaves in Georgia with TV ads.**

CALL TO ACTION

OCTOBER 13, 2022

Dear Friends,

Some of you may not be aware from Sept. 28 to Oct. 3, the Republican party
cancelled Campaign Sidekick phone calling and door knocking in respect to
the people of Florida who were harmed by Ian.

We are “back in business” door knocking, putting out signs, and making
phone calls. We ask that you keep a daily record of how many doors you have
knock on and calls made. Please keep a daily tally for yes or no vote
for DeSantis, Rubio and candidate Wimbish. This way we can do our own
Survey on how well the candidates are doing. Please email or text JuDian,
Email: impeccablejg@gmail.com or text 407-607-6497.

Attaching a calendar please schedule what you can do and send your info to
JuDian. Call/text 407-607-6497. Please use the attached form to record
calls made using the” Campaign Sidekick Survey beginning Oct. 13.”

1. If you want yard signs, contact Judy Collins call/text 407-595-0569

2. If you want to knock on doors, contact JuDian call/text 407-607-6497

3. If you want to make calls, contact JuDian call/text 407-607-6497

4. If you want to work at the FRA HQ, contact Amania call/text
908-248-7845

name: Raphael Warnock
subject: My debate with Herschel Walker
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend, Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day.
I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, but we have a problem : With experts at FiveThirtyEight saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me.
That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.
We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign, friend. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy.
Unlike Walker, I refuse to take a cent from corporate PACs. From the very start, I’ve relied entirely on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory – so I have to urgently ask you in this important moment: Before the midnight deadline, will you split a donation between Serve America and me to help hit our fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-warnock?refcode=20221013_SA_RW]
It means so much to have you by my side. Thank you.
– Rev. Raphael Warnock

subject: Here's my record:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
I’ve delivered for Pennsylvanians

Derek, I’ll be a strong Governor for Pennsylvanians. But before I explain why you can trust me to be a Governor Pennsylvanians can count on, I need to ask for your support. Asking people for money is not something I enjoy doing, but my team informed me that we’re falling behind our online fundraising goals, so it’s necessary. **[Will you donate today to help us get back on track?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52562748/372644921/-586780698?refcode=email_101322_RESEND_countonme_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=fab6b428-3a4b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWI2YjQyOC0zYTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYwGt9F9V-oaiFbsaeYmc19jRoYLI-V0UdF2rFo9PzE=)** I’ve made it my mission to put the people of Pennsylvanians first — I’ve defended our freedom to choose, our voices at the ballot box, our right to clean water and air, and our ability to provide for their families. Here’s how: As State Representative, I helped write and pass some of the toughest ethics laws in state history — taking on the status quo for Pennsylvanians. As County Commissioner, I led a fiscal and ethical turnaround. I put the county back on solid financial footing, took early steps to combat the heroin epidemic, helped the first LGBTQ+ couples in Pennsylvania marry, and fired Wall Street money managers to save taxpayers and retirees millions. As the People’s Attorney General, I exposed the Catholic Church’s decades-long cover-up of child sexual abuse, identifying 301 predator priests and thousands of victims. I forced an agreement between two of the Commonwealth’s largest insurance companies — protecting health care access for almost 2 million Pennsylvanians, and I’ve repeatedly gone to court to defend Pennsylvanians’ reproductive rights and a woman’s right to choose. During the 2020 presidential election, I protected the right to vote and defended Pennsylvania’s election results, winning in court dozens of times before and after Election Day. To this day, I’m still calling out the dangerous lies that undermine our democracy — especially the conspiracy theories coming from Doug Mastriano — and fighting to protect our voting rights in Pennsylvania. Now, in my second term, I’m continuing to stand up for Pennsylvanians, take on big fights, and deliver real results. I’m keeping our streets safe by arresting more than 8,200 drug dealers and taking thousands of illegal guns off the streets. I’ve delivered hundreds of millions in relief for Pennsylvanian students, seniors, and workers who have been ripped off by greedy corporations. **I have a track record of taking on the big fights and delivering for Pennsylvanians. Now, I’m taking on the biggest fight yet: Winning this competitive Governor’s race, beating dangerous extremist Doug Mastriano, and defending all of our freedoms.** But to win, I need your help. This campaign can’t be won by one person or even a handful — it’ll take a huge, powerful team to win in a swing state like Pennsylvania, why is why I’m asking for your support today: **[Derek, will you donate today to our people-powered campaign? I need your help to get us back on track to hit our online fundraising goals — click here to contribute.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52562749/372644922/-586780698?refcode=email_101322_RESEND_countonme_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=fab6b428-3a4b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWI2YjQyOC0zYTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYwGt9F9V-oaiFbsaeYmc19jRoYLI-V0UdF2rFo9PzE=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52562750/372644923/-586780698?refcode=email_101322_RESEND_countonme_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&express_lane=true&refcode2=fab6b428-3a4b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWI2YjQyOC0zYTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UYwGt9F9V-oaiFbsaeYmc19jRoYLI-V0UdF2rFo9PzE=)

clean_body: | | | | Hageman unveils massive grassroots team of over 500 county leaders Harriet Hageman, Republican nominee for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wyoming, today released a truly massive list of who are active in their communities and represent her campaign to their neighbors. The volunteers are helping to spread Hageman’s message that Wyomingites need a member of Congress who will fight against D.C. insiders who are intent on destroying their way of life. Since declaring her candidacy in September 2021, Hageman has traveled 45,000 miles across Wyoming, held hundreds of public events and town halls, and had conversations with thousands of Wyoming voters. “The people of Wyoming are motivated and demanding that Washington, D.C. pay attention to them, and I am thrilled and honored that so many have joined our campaign in leadership positions,” Hageman said. “Joe Biden and the radicals in Washington are attacking us daily, shutting down our energy and resource industries, encroaching on our constitutional rights, and weakening our country in all respects. We only get one member of Congress in Wyoming and we have to make it count, so from the moment I’m sworn in, I will do what I always do – fight for Wyoming.” Hageman was born and raised in Wyoming and learned the value of hard work and loyalty on her family’s ranch outside of Fort Laramie. She has built her legal career fighting federal overreach, standing up for water, property and constitutional rights. Hageman soundly defeated incumbent Rep. Liz Cheney in the August 16 Republican primary, earning two-thirds of the vote for a 37-point victory, and is heavily favored to win the general election on November 8. View the full list of grassroots leaders . | | | |

Fellow American,

**Tomorrow, Raphael Warnock and I will meet in Savannah for a U.S. Senate debate.**

I'm looking forward to giving voters an opportunity to see two very different visions for Georgia's future.

If you agree with open borders, ending cash bail, packing the Supreme Court with liberal justices, allowing taxpayer-funded abortions up to the moment of birth, or increasing government spending so inflation continues, Senator Warnock is your candidate. _**He has supported all these things while voting 96% of the time with Joe Biden.**_

If you believe in securing our border, supporting law enforcement, standing up for life, becoming energy independent, reducing spending to get inflation under control, and getting America back on the right track, I'm your candidate. _**I'll fight to defeat the disastrous Biden agenda in the U.S. Senate.**_

**It's really that simple, and I trust the voters will see those differences tomorrow.**

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

clean_body: It's never been more important to elect leaders who are going to use their position to advocate for and defend our freedoms. Fair Fight | | | As voters begin returning their mail ballots and in-person early voting starts in four days, all eyes are on Georgia. This is shaping up to be one of the most competitive states in this year’s midterms, so we have no time to waste — because our futures and the Senate will be decided by Georgia voters. This year alone, we’ve seen unprecedented attacks on some of our most fundamental rights. With so much at stake, it's never been more important to elect leaders who are going to use their position to advocate for and defend our freedoms — leaders like Senator Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams, who are both tireless advocates for voters. = Senator Raphael Warnock has been a leading voice calling for federal voting rights protections, and has served the people of Georgia for the past year and a half in the Senate delivering billions of dollars in relief to Americans and fighting for affordable healthcare. Stacey Abrams is a champion for voting rights and is running for governor to ensure every Georgian not only has access to the ballot box, but also to healthcare, housing, education, and a good living. # **Patti Campaign Hosts Reformed Mob Captain, Author Michael Franzese**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - Supervisor Tom Patti is touring the Valley to set the record straight with a series of town hall events. Next Saturday, October 22 at 2 PM he will be at the First Baptist Church in Stockton with Michael Franzese, who went from mob boss to Christian to motivational speaker to best-selling author.

Franzese was one of New York’s most notorious mobsters before being sent to prison. He was depicted in Martin Scorsese’s movie “Goodfellas.” While in prison he was handed a bible and devoted his life to God and family. He is now married with five children and changing lives with his books and motivational speaking. He recently returned from 25 speaking engagements in Europe.

His new book is “Mafia Democracy: How Our Republic Became a Mob Racket.” In it he highlights disturbing parallels between today’s political leaders and mob bosses.

He is in town to support Supervisor Patti in his run for Congress. They were introduced through a mutual friend earlier this year. “Tom is one of the good guys,” said Franzese. “He is that rare politician who is genuinely in it to make other peoples’ lives better, not his own.”

About Franzese, Supervisor Patti said, “Michael is a shining example that you can turn your life around at anytime and find redemption. I am inspired by his story and honored to have his support.”

The event is free. To attend, click the button below to RSVP. Prior to the event there will be a VIP lunch and book signing with Franzese and Supervisor Patti. For more information on the VIP event, contact Gina Brown Rishwain at [gina.rishwain@yahoo.com](mailto:gina.rishwain@yahoo.com) or call 310-560-9855.

| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

body:
Hi there, Peter.
Last week, my team released a new [TV ad](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52541507/372598551/-1681467643?refcode=em-10.13.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzE1ZjAzMS0xZTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rBOF7AX8niFw53XIFuHB7in2r3j9iHD5Qudkg6GBQpY=). In it, I pledge to help you fight back against the “storm” bearing down on us. From prescription drug costs to the assault on reproductive rights, we’re facing urgent problems that need to be tackled in Washington. My new ad makes it crystal clear that I’m the only candidate in this race committed to addressing our biggest challenges while putting the interests of the people of IL-17 first.
This probably won’t shock you but it’s expensive to keep ads on the air, and we need to make our final cash wire to local TV stations before tomorrow at 5:00pm if we want to keep it live for another week. Right now, we’re a bit short of our target goal.
Peter, I’m hoping you can help keep our ad on the air so we can reach undecided voters in IL-17. If you’re able, please chip in a grassroots contribution of $3 before midnight.
Here’s a good link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q4-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52541508/372598552/-396165772?refcode=em-10.13.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzE1ZjAzMS0xZTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rBOF7AX8niFw53XIFuHB7in2r3j9iHD5Qudkg6GBQpY=)**
We adjusted our budget to get this ad on the air earlier than we’d planned, because the super PACs spending on behalf of my opponent are driving up the price of TV time. The goal here is to be as efficient as possible with your contributions.
By tomorrow’s deadline, we’re hoping to bring in another $35,000 to keep our ad on the airwaves. It would mean a lot to me to have your help getting our campaign’s message to voters. After all, there are only 26 days until Election Day. We need to reach people across Northwest Illinois to really get out the vote next month.
If you can, give us a boost in the final weeks of this campaign by helping us stay live with our TV ad. Here’s that link one more time: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q4-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52541509/372598553/-396165772?refcode=em-10.13.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzE1ZjAzMS0xZTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rBOF7AX8niFw53XIFuHB7in2r3j9iHD5Qudkg6GBQpY=)**

Eric

body:
need a hand

| Friend

**_It’s been a rough day._**

I hate giving you bad news, but it’s important - my team let me know that we might not hit our October goal! This is a problem because the election is so close.

# **Patti Campaign Hosts Reformed Mob Captain, Author Michael Franzese**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - Supervisor Tom Patti is touring the Valley to set the record straight with a series of town hall events. Next Saturday, October 22 at 2 PM he will be at the First Baptist Church in Stockton with Michael Franzese, who went from mob boss to Christian to motivational speaker to best-selling author.

Franzese was one of New York’s most notorious mobsters before being sent to prison. He was depicted in Martin Scorsese’s movie “Goodfellas.” While in prison he was handed a bible and devoted his life to God and family. He is now married with five children and changing lives with his books and motivational speaking. He recently returned from 25 speaking engagements in Europe.

His new book is “Mafia Democracy: How Our Republic Became a Mob Racket.” In it he highlights disturbing parallels between today’s political leaders and mob bosses.

He is in town to support Supervisor Patti in his run for Congress. They were introduced through a mutual friend earlier this year. “Tom is one of the good guys,” said Franzese. “He is that rare politician who is genuinely in it to make other peoples’ lives better, not his own.”

About Franzese, Supervisor Patti said, “Michael is a shining example that you can turn your life around at anytime and find redemption. I am inspired by his story and honored to have his support.”

The event is free. To attend, click the button below to RSVP. Prior to the event there will be a VIP lunch and book signing with Franzese and Supervisor Patti. For more information on the VIP event, contact Gina Brown Rishwain at [gina.rishwain@yahoo.com](mailto:gina.rishwain@yahoo.com) or call 310-560-9855.

| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

Derek, We’ve set an ambitious mid-month goal for the final month before Election Day. **By 11:59 PM on October 15, we need to have raised $20,000.** Thanks to donors like you, we know that we can do this. Fellow American,

**Tomorrow, Raphael Warnock and I will meet in Savannah for a U.S. Senate debate.**

If you agree with open borders, ending cash bail, packing the Supreme Court with liberal justices, allowing taxpayer-funded abortions up to the moment of birth, or increasing government spending so inflation continues, Senator Warnock is your candidate. _**He has supported all these things while voting 96% of the time with Joe Biden.**_

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52566956/372660467/-863883417?refcode=em_res_2022.10.13_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTc2OWI0Ni00NjRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3L0PKbTz8fgmzL7zyoNxH3pgf6zv75tZkbgx4ATSSOE=) Today is the U.S. Navy’s birthday, so I want to take a moment to celebrate all my fellow Sailors who have worn the uniform and who can say with great pride that they served in the world’s greatest Navy.

**Ship, Shipmate, Self.**

Derek, that’s one of the first lessons I learned at the Naval Academy. You put the mission first, and you put others before yourself. **These values are core for me, and they're what this campaign for our common good is all about.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52566957/372660468/-863883417?refcode=em_res_2022.10.13_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTc2OWI0Ni00NjRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3L0PKbTz8fgmzL7zyoNxH3pgf6zv75tZkbgx4ATSSOE=) **Fighting for our common good means putting people first. And when I’m in Congress, you can count on me to never lose sight of that mission.**

I’ll never stop advocating for the union way of life, for our small businesses and bringing manufacturing back home, for our wives and daughters to have access to an abortion without fear of being thrown in jail, for our LGBTQ+ sisters and brothers to move freely through society rather than live in the shadows, and for the end of unnecessary wars.

You can’t count on the radical right to do any of that. **In fact, all you _can_ count on is that my opponent will side with huge corporations and right-wing extremists over working families in western Pennsylvania _every single time._** They care about power and profit at whatever cost.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Do you know what they're doing to your kids?!
body:
Join the fight to protect our kids | | | My fellow concerned American, Imagine that you’ve just been called into the middle school principal’s office to have a “serious talk” about your daughter. You’re worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been “educating” your preteen daughter -- for months, in total secret -- about how to “transition” her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you “can’t be trusted.” That you, her parent, are not “safe.” But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn’t you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it’s no surprise that’s exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter’s California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who “groomed” her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law.** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4da2603bf10b4c2eb3a63614bb979ace&_e=3QLWibXjqadR3xsdBg_V0txxxuVpUN_DFkspf_U2ciAQma1cdkVkYIVsyblIH6gv3SJQSi0-h2r5wK6LAfcOHSfOiMXL_NcV63BTvwLtqkGilI0YsJXv3WnSqJ7WDh8aMAue7jK5f2VeKlyzDXwpy-6igR7XQJ3cRwu5P5Wjk0fufQ9lAloFhARybN3gGTMbtpHc84dPoup1DPmMHt5j98I5x-VmMpfhO8hdMulSk2Ka5TRJNkAwgs8NZUs089FFh3qzw5PlCj7U8bziMF9_HKSKkiXpPh4lPSjbrQa2oOUWLfrT2OHmgWJ5gcPPJ6-T85V0zmeCqt6t3Yhb-uLCXFEAIj_m6GhAwv4FZ9QRig4_NBUM10SKa_Ar8h8nEinCIr9RpKqGRi-c43cq-FQVDg%3D%3D) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica’s daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called “Equality Club”? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably “transgender.”_** “But don’t tell your parents!” they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. body:

| | |
---
Friend,
JD Vance’s book, "Hillbilly Elegy", costs $7.85.
You can buy a copy to use as a coaster (or a doorstop, or a chew toy for your dog), OR you can donate $7.85 to our campaign to flip Ohio blue and expand the Senate majority.
