body:
This is a *big deal*, Derek.
#
In less than one week from today, we will be required to file one last FEC fundraising report before Election Day. **This is a *big deal*, Derek.**
I’ll explain why in a minute, but first: **[Can you make a donation of any amount today? It’s *so* important that our campaign reports strong fundraising numbers leading into November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221013-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221013-7695&refcode2=7695_434096_H0JkS3&akid=7695%2E434096%2EH0JkS3)**
This is the last time our fundraising numbers will be published before the election, which means the number we report is going to be THE final fundraising update voters see before heading to the polls.
In other words, Derek, this is our _last_ chance to prove to our family, friends, and neighbors that we can flip this open U.S. Senate seat + protect our Democratic Senate majority.
If we outraise Oz in this report through the power of grassroots donations, the press will highlight the strength of our campaign. If we are outraised by Oz, they could say our campaign is losing steam.
TL;DR: We _need_ to go *all out* before this FEC deadline on October 19, Derek.
**Which is why today, we’re launching an ambitious goal: 100,000 contributions before our FEC deadline.**
Yes, how much we raise is important. But there’s another number that I think better demonstrates how strong our campaign is: **How many people are inspired to actually chip in + support our people powered campaign.**
**[Can you please make a donation of any amount today to help us reach our milestone goal of receiving 100,000 unique donations before midnight on October 19? No matter how much you chip in, your support is crucial in helping us reach this goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221013-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221013-7695&refcode2=7695_434096_H0JkS3&akid=7695%2E434096%2EH0JkS3)**

I know we can do this with your help,
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It’s not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It’s because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here’s the kicker. The Sacketts’ land is not wet. There’s no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn’t comply with the EPA’s outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights—**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That’s why I’m emailing you today with a special request. I’m hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there’s no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA’s blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d76cbeba2a5245d99680e237d6043dfe&_e=vcg4EuZwmhsp10As9KtL_Yh_2JCLP_o_JUiLE1uqEsMg9dQd0znRuE9oU5YZv6C385O7HoIrAKk0opkXkDeBELJBfh0Sd3LSl5gpQwoTnxIVjOaAHQNdt7L5GD8N7plpQ8fn2dujeTRsgtDXjGCo_EWskM6iN8zsLvlRFJb05a1l5F0qEm5ljI9i0bShCXbkD1V3Nu3Und9EjLmzZL3zfbrBAeILkJJUuahHvw0IcmBsRlj0kbR3jE6Z0Nzw8Hk5MRpq0NLnXrb7s9PD0O639wS10px8dEYjb6PHnZjCdP3ufbcXrkNluTOzNScLTyXbbZLqYpFgYgV28dh-OOd2_HaelIL-ss-4kVWh11lJKbI%3D)** For Liberty! #

Hi,
I’m writing to ask you to split a contribution between my campaign and Senator Michael Bennet’s re-election campaign in Colorado.
I’ll explain more about why I’m asking in a moment, but if you already know about Senator Bennet and are ready to chip in to keep him in the Senate, you can make your donation at this link:

Ok, here’s the situation:
This is one of the closest — and most under the radar — Senate races in the country. Mitch McConnell has called Michael’s opponent a “perfect candidate” and his Super PAC has already spent millions attacking Michael.
And that’s _in addition_ to the millions of his own money that Michael’s GOP opponent has poured into this race.
Now, polling shows this race in a statistical tie, and with voting officially starting in Colorado in **less than one week** , Michael is counting on our support to fight back against these attacks and win.

Let’s be honest, folks. It’s that time of year as the election approaches — when “politically motivated” establishment Democrats jump up and down with the “go out and vote” and the “we need to win up and down the ballot” message...

But I know firsthand from when I ran for office that when it comes to actually pitching in and rallying behind down-ballot working-class progressives, the support just isn’t there — until it’s too late. **The candidates who need tangible grassroots action the most are the ones who often get left behind.

** Take **_Angelina Jackson_** for example. Angie is running for Judge of Common Pleas Court in Montgomery County, Ohio.

Like all of our **Barrier to Entry PAC** candidates, Angie comes from a working-class background. Born and raised in Dayton and a long-time Montgomery County resident, she truly understands the struggles that working families in her community face. **_Angie is a Black mom and an attorney who is ready to bring her acumen, diversity, and lived experience to the bench.

We need dedicated public leaders like Angie fighting for justice, defending our rights, and leveling the playing field. The outcome of this November’s elections will have big repercussions for the next presidential election and for our democracy as a whole. Whether pro-democracy candidates win in states across the country _this year_ could determine whether election results are even certified in 2024.

That’s why it’s critical that we do everything we can to fight back. And as A.G. Holder said, that means we have to _do_ democracy. **It isn’t enough to just vote** — we all need to do our part by supporting candidates who are committed to protecting voting rights and ensuring our democracy survives for future generations.
To that end, **the NDRC has endorsed more than 400 Democracy Defenders** who are running for key offices in target states all over the country. From state legislators and governors to secretaries of state and state supreme court justices, we _must_ make sure the officials who win this November will do everything they can to protect our democracy.

Hey Peter, I’m on the campaign trail today and know you’re busy too so I'll keep this quick.
**The Democrat Party does not care about you, your job, your family, or this country anymore. **

subject: I am debating Ron Johnson tonight, and I need your help to send a powerful message about the strength of this campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
We have a huge amount of work ahead of us, and the weeks ahead will not be easy.
#
Friends -
Tonight I am facing Ron Johnson in our final debate, and I would like to tell you why I need a lot of donations before I take the debate stage this evening.
Here's the truth:
From the moment I launched this campaign, I knew that we'd need a lot of people making small contributions in order to keep up with Ron Johnson's corporate PAC money and right-wing mega-donors.
I'm very proud of what we've accomplished together. Hundreds of thousands of people have come together to help fund this campaign, and that support means the world to me.
I wish I didn't have to ask you to chip in today, but that's what I need to do if we're going to have the resources to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and defeat Ron Johnson.
So before tonight's debate begins, I am looking for a large number of donations to send a powerful message about the grassroots strength of this campaign.
[**Can I count on you to add your first $3 online contribution before tonight's debate? If you can do it today, you will help ensure we have the resources to win while sending an unmistakable message about the strength of our campaign before tonight's debate.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221013-1-acq-sp2&t=1&akid=3563%2E196590%2En7HsME)
The weeks ahead will not be easy. So far Republicans have spent $31 million on attack ads against me, and that doesn't even count the ads they're running to try to prop up Ron Johnson.
They've seen all the latest polls that show this race is a statistical tie. And they know that if Ron Johnson wins re-election in Wisconsin, Republicans are essentially guaranteed to regain the Senate majority.
So I need your help. Especially before tonight's debate. Because lots of grassroots donations is the only way we will have the resources required to flip this seat.
That's why I am asking one more time:
[**Will you chip in $3 before tonight's debate begins? This debate is a big deal for our campaign, and every donation helps put us in a position to flip this seat.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221013-1-acq-sp2&t=2&akid=3563%2E196590%2En7HsME)
When I’m on stage debating Ron Johnson tonight, I’ll be thinking of this grassroots team that is going to send him packing in November.
Thanks for adding your donation before tonight's debate. As long as we are in this together, there is nothing we cannot accomplish.
All my best,
Mandela

| Dear Fellow American,

As always, our members make possible everything Judicial Watch does to successfully battle corrupt politicians and stand firm for the rule of law and our "right to know."
Because of our members’ commitment, we can respond _quickly and decisively_ to meet the challenges posed by corrupt politicians and unlawfully secretive government bureaucrats.
Our ability to take on new investigations and lawsuits is critical to our success...and [it is one very important reason why I am asking you to give your support to Judicial Watch today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60628&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

---

For example, we were in federal court _just one day after_ the FBI launched its unprecedented raid on former President Trump's Florida home with our lawsuit asking the court to unseal the search warrant materials used by the FBI!

Now that's what I call impact.

And we are now working on multiple fronts important to all commonsense conservatives these days...and [that's why I am counting on you for your help today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60628&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60628&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

* _We are breaking new ground challenging the radical Left 's efforts to create laws and programs with quotas that unlawfully discriminate against individuals based on race, gender, ethnicity and sexual preference_. We overturned two discriminatory quota laws in California related to corporate boards of directors, _and we recently filed a lawsuit on behalf of a taxpayer over a teacher 's contract in the Minneapolis Public Schools that provides discriminatory job protections to certain racial minorities. _

* We continue to _challenge the conspiracy of government officials, the liberal media and others to protect President Joe Biden and his son Hunter from scrutiny related to allegations of wrongdoing and corruption_ , as well as challenging federal agencies' ongoing cover-up for the Bidens on Hunter's overseas influence peddling schemes... _and we are doggedly using the courts to release records that the American people have a right to see_!

* And _our election integrity team of attorneys is performing state-by-state research to determine if we need to file more lawsuits_ against state and county officials who fail to combat voter fraud by _cleaning their voter rolls_ as federal law requires!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60628&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

We're also currently pursuing _thousands_ of open Freedom of Information Act requests and a record number of lawsuits against several branches of the federal government on multiple and important policy fronts. But all of them carry real costs, [which is why your decision to join the Judicial Watch team with a special contribution now would mean so much to us.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60628&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

On behalf of the entire Judicial Watch team, thank you for your past support to help us advance our mission on behalf of the rule of law and the American people's right to know... _[please let us know we can count on you today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60628&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_!

name: James Marter
subject: CHICAGO Reception with Tudor Dixon Republican candidate for MICHIGAN Governor!
body:
_Hi Friends,_
_ _
_I 'm on the front lines with the Illinois grassroots in this Very Important Election. So when I was asked to help SAVE MICHIGAN, where My wife and I began our married life together, where our four children were born, and we lived for a dozen years, I said YES, YES MICHIGAN!_
_ _
_I'm helping out my friends El Gerson and Scott Kaspar, who are hosting a reception October 18th, 5-7 pm, downtown Chicago for Tudor Dixon, Republican candidate for Michigan Governor. El was the chair of the Trump campaign in Illinois, and Scott ran for the Republican nomination in IL-06 this past June, and like me, proudly carried the endorsements of conservative groups like Illinois Family Action._

_Tudor Dixon is an America First candidate who was one of the first gubernatorial candidates to get Donald Trump's full endorsement. The Michigan governor race is one that mainstream media is fixated with, because all of the national polls have Tudor within the margin of error with her nefarious Democrat opponent, Gretchen Whitmer. _

_If you're interested in learning more about the October 18th event, reach out to Lauren Bosler at [lbosler@templarbaker.com](mailto:lbosler@templarbaker.com), or reach out to me and I'll be happy to put you in contact with El and Scott._
**__[Best regards, Jim Marter ](http://www.marter4congress.us/)__**
**_Kendall County Republican Party Chairman
Republican Collar County Regional VP RCCA_** _

_**Phone: ** (815) 585-8006 **e-mail:** [James@Marter4Congress.US ](mailto:James@Marter4Congress.US) ** FB:** [www.facebook.com/Marter4Congress](http://www.facebook.com/Marter4Congress)
**Website: **[www.Marter4Congress.US](http://www.marter4congress.us/)
**

Oswego, IL 60543** __**

When we launched this campaign, we pledged to protect direct democracy and the power of voters,_**and since then, we’ve done just that.**_ [**One year after the launch of our Ballot Measure Rescue Campaign, will you make a donation to power our fight to protect ballot measures for years to come?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52562918/372645469/-267449566?refcode=E18759-20221013-BMRCAnniversary-SL-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRlAvMS84NTQ3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjQ2M2Y4Yy0zYTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RJgMODvBFX6dbFWO7soCL98azFju0AW8uMggD8A5yww=) **In 2021, 87 bills were introduced in state legislatures to harm the ballot measure process. And this year, the attacks haven’t stalled — extremists are even using ballot measures _to try and restrict the power of ballot measures (!!)_** **In South Dakota,** Amendment C went up for a vote in June. If passed, it would have raised the threshold to win any future measures to a 60% supermajority;_a move that the extremists backing the measure even admitted was an attempt to block the passage of Medicaid expansion in the state this November._ **We used our BMRC to fight back and protect democracy in South Dakota,_and won._** **But let’s be clear: South Dakota isn’t the only place where we’re seeing these attacks happen in real-time:** _In November, Arizonans and Arkansans will be voting on their own copycat amendments to bump up the approval threshold for ballot measures to 60%._ **We will not stand by as extremist officials attack one of our most powerful, most democratic tools _just because they’re scared of the progress we as voters have been able to achieve._** **Our Ballot Measure Rescue Campaign is locked and loaded — ready to fight to preserve direct democracy however that may be.** Where we need to bring litigation, we will litigate. Where we can stop bad laws from being passed, we will run aggressive campaigns to stop these anti-democratic bills. And where the legislature refers suppressive measures to the ballot, **we will fight to win those ballot campaigns.** [**To continue this critical work we need your support, friend. clean_body: | | Friend, One year ago, we launched our Ballot Measure Rescue Campaign (BMRC), a $5 million effort dedicated to fighting back against attacks on one of the most democratic and powerful tools we as voters have available to us: ballot measures. When we launched this campaign, we pledged to protect direct democracy and the power of voters,and since then, we’ve done just that. = In 2021, 87 bills were introduced in state legislatures to harm the ballot measure process. And this year, the attacks haven’t stalled — extremists are even using ballot measures to try and restrict the power of ballot measures (!!) In South Dakota, Amendment C went up for a vote in June. If passed, it would have raised the threshold to win any future measures to a 60% supermajority;a move that the extremists backing the measure even admitted was an attempt to block the passage of Medicaid expansion in the state this November. We used our BMRC to fight back and protect democracy in South Dakota,and won. But let’s be clear: South Dakota isn’t the only place where we’re seeing these attacks happen in real-time: In November, Arizonans and Arkansans will be voting on their own copycat amendments to bump up the approval threshold for ballot measures to 60%. We will not stand by as extremist officials attack one of our most powerful, most democratic tools just because they’re scared of the progress we as voters have been able to achieve. Our Ballot Measure Rescue Campaign is locked and loaded — ready to fight to preserve direct democracy however that may be. Where we need to bring litigation, we will litigate. Where we can stop bad laws from being passed, we will run aggressive campaigns to stop these anti-democratic bills. This is going to be a tough race — one of the closest in the country. Every decision, every door knock and every dollar matters.

| Peter,

When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue.

I don’t want any of us to wake up on November 9 with regrets. We need to know we gave it our all, made the best decisions possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested.

You may ask why I feel so strongly about this, and the truth is that my race for Chief Justice in 2020 was ultimately decided by 401 votes — out of over 5 million.

Yes, that’s just how close these races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done.

And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin in November. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied.

So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat.

I’m so grateful for everyone who has pitched in their time and talent already.

And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin in November. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied. So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat. I’m so grateful for everyone who has pitched in their time and talent already. = | | | = | = | = | = | = This is going to be a tough race — one of the closest in the country. Every decision, every door knock and every dollar matters. But together, I am confident that we will have the resources and grassroots strength it takes to win! Our big win in 2020 has been a focal point of Republicans and Trump for the last two years.

Trump is putting everything he has into making sure his handpicked candidates – who have practically promised him an Arizona victory in 2024 no matter what the actual votes say – win this year. **Trump thinks if he can pull his extreme candidates to victories, he’ll be able to return to Arizona and launch his next presidential campaign.**

Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control. If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power. I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. That's why I need you to join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto protect this seat and our majority. **[I’m personally asking you: Will you split $25 between Catherine’s campaign and BlueAmp Action to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and defend our Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7b54a5ff-4d54-47d0-86d2-0399117e7508/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| I've been an activist my entire life, Peter. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the millions, to usher in great progress for this nation. But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election. If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip this seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet for the return of the impeached former president. It's why Donald Trump himself flew all the way to Nevada to hold one of his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win. **[Please, rush $25 or whatever you can spare to fight back against Trump, help Catherine Cortez Masto win in Nevada and protect our Democratic Senate majority.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb9ab1c63-1f44-48b5-b0bb-83327739a2bb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) ** Thank you, Martin Sheen

Hi there,
It took Ted (the character I played on “How I Met Your Mother”) nine seasons to tell the whole story, but we don’t have that kind of time — so I’ll just cut to the chase and tell you about why this election is one of the most important of our lifetimes.
The Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and national Republicans are threatening a nationwide abortion ban if they take back the Senate. We HAVE to take action to elect the leaders who fight for the things we care about. Leaders who fight to make things better.
That’s why I want to talk to you about Maggie Hassan.

name: Brenda Siegel
subject: Let me tell you a story
body:
| |
---
Friend, 26 years ago today I was at work at a Dennys when my roommate called my work because he had expected me home a while ago. He said 7 words that would change my life forever. "You have to call your dad...now." **** I went to the pay phone and called him. My dad said, "Bren, Johnathon died today". I stood at the window on the payphone in the restaurant and said "no no no no no no..." for how long, I don't know. I was 19 years old and my dear big brother, the dad of my adorable nephew, Kaya, was gone. **** I could not have conceptualized in that moment the ways in which life would change forever. For me and Kaya, for my entire family. He died while using heroin. I stood there at his grave, watching his baby, thinking I would do everything in my power to make Kaya's life ok. Just over 20 years later, Kaya died the same way. My niece was 19 experiencing the same thing I had at the same age. I have never felt so broken in my life. **** 26 years have passed since my brother, Johnathon Siegel died. I miss him just as much today as I did then. Sometimes more. **** What I didn't know then, but I do know now is that his death was preventable. Trauma is the number one indicator for substance use disorder and preventing his death would likely have prevented Kaya's. Keeping people alive IS prevention.
---
|
---
It is long past time to use up to date science and data to stop this for those who are not lost yet. My story is not unique. And nothing I do will change my family's outcome, our story has been determined. However, we can save the lives of others who are still here. It is time for us to put harm reduction first, treatment and recovery on demand including medically assisted treatment on demand and criminal justice reform. The Governor vetoed three bills that would have saved people's lives, people like Johnathon. People like Kaya. We have the tools to save lives. We have to use them. clean_body: | | Friend, 26 years ago today I was at work at a Dennys when my roommate called my work because he had expected me home a while ago. He said 7 words that would change my life forever. "You have to call your dad...now." ** I went to the pay phone and called him. My dad said, "Bren, Johnathon died today". I stood at the window on the payphone in the restaurant and said "no no no no no no..." for how long, I don't know. I was 19 years old and my dear big brother, the dad of my adorable nephew, Kaya, was gone. I could not have conceptualized in that moment the ways in which life would change forever. For me and Kaya, for my entire family. He died while using heroin. I stood there at his grave, watching his baby, thinking I would do everything in my power to make Kaya's life ok. Just over 20 years later, Kaya died the same way. My niece was 19 experiencing the same thing I had at the same age. I have never felt so broken in my life. 26 years have passed since my brother, Johnathon Siegel died. I miss him just as much today as I did then. Sometimes more. ** What I didn't know then, but I do know now is that his death was preventable. Trauma is the number one indicator for substance use disorder and preventing his death would likely have prevented Kaya's. Keeping people alive IS prevention. | It is long past time to use up to date science and data to stop this for those who are not lost yet. My story is not unique. And nothing I do will change my family's outcome, our story has been determined. However, we can save the lives of others who are still here. It is time for us to put harm reduction first, treatment and recovery on demand including medically assisted treatment on demand and criminal justice reform. The Governor vetoed three bills that would have saved people's lives, people like Johnathon. People like Kaya. We have the tools to save lives. We have to use them. name: Marcus Flowers
subject: This is who I am, this is why I'm running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marcus for Georgia
body:
I'm going to defeat Marjorie Taylor Greene

|
---
[](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzsn0D366fuE1hyM8nYo_dxU31BkPDgzNDblrL2FcJ8IJ3mhUZ55u0d3INKQCYmVLpM&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=221013_whyrs_nfl&n=1) Hi, it’s Marcus Flowers, Democratic Army Veteran running for Congress against Marjorie Taylor Greene.

**Here’s what I want you to know about me:** I was born in Troy, Alabama, the birthplace of civil rights icon John Lewis.

I joined the Army right out of high school and served for 27 years overseas as a soldier including a decade fighting in Iraq and Afghanistan.

Service has always been a major part of my life. So when I watched the events of January 6th -- when a Confederate battle flag was paraded through the Capitol rotunda and police officers were beaten with it, I was shocked.

And knowing that my representative, Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, had actually helped incite the mob that attacked our Capitol, I knew I had to act.

_**The very next day, I resigned my post as a government official and decided to run against her.**_

Since then, our campaign has grown at a record pace, and we’ve out-raised Marjorie Taylor Greene for three consecutive quarters.

I know we can win, flip this seat, and send Marjorie Taylor Greene into political retirement. But it’s going to take a MASSIVE team effort to do it.

[**So with less than 30 days remaining in this campaign, I need to ask you to dig deep: Can you chip in $20 or more to help my campaign finish what it started and DEFEAT Marjorie Taylor Greene once and for all?**](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzsn0D366fuE1hyM8nYo_dxU31BkPDgzNDblrL2FcJ8IJ3mhUZ55u0d3INKQCYmVLpM&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=221013_whyrs_nfl&n=2)

---
When I launched this campaign against Marjorie Taylor Greene in a historically red district, I knew it wouldn’t be easy. But supporters like you from all across our country have backed me up every step of the way -- and it’s clear we have the momentum on our side.

**I can’t thank you enough for your support. But we can’t rest now. We have to keep going.**
****
Please join me.

Let’s do this,
Marcus Flowers

When Democrats have no ground to stand on, they ALWAYS pivot to attacking Republicans on social issues. We are seeing this right now in the Georgia Senate race. Democrats have no desire to talk about crime in our neighborhoods, rising gas prices, open borders, or 40-year high inflation. Instead, they want to distract voters from the real issues, so they attack me personally and make up lie after lie. And now, they're coming after you, too. We cannot let them win, Peter. If we fail to flip this Senate seat in less than four weeks, they will have won - in no small part by attacking people of faith. The Left's attacks against us will never end, but this election will. | | | Hey there,

**We are less than one week away from the most important fundraising deadline of the campaign. **

This deadline is going to show how much my opponent’s special interest groups and party bosses are throwing down to keep up their longstanding traditions of inaction and corruption. [I need your help to really have the momentum it’ll take to get us to Election Day and take back our seat in Congress.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4162581088&e=356c0699dd)

Our message for fresh, common-sense leadership in Washington has had tremendous reach. Part of my district that usually goes red is currently polling dead-even. This is proof that the hard work that every volunteer and Democratic candidate has been putting in, meeting people where they are, and listening to their concerns is working!

**We are actively showing Scott Fitzgerald and his bosses that enough is enough: we want a leader in Congress who will work for everyone, and who will be accountable to his constituents**.

[Can I count on you to help us keep up this momentum with a donation of $100, $75, $50, or even $25 today?](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=874c9a3c1b&e=356c0699dd)

---
| [DONATE](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=f9a79ae05a&e=356c0699dd "DONATE")
---
| _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ [Express Donate: $100](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=0ac97899d7&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $75](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=4a598d16c6&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $50](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=10ede5c817&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $25](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=2047364112&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $10](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=dead21c3db&e=356c0699dd) [Express Donate: $5](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=85b6d1722d&e=356c0699dd) [Or, donate another amount](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=102af35206&e=356c0699dd) While we have a winning message, we don’t have a multi-million-dollar budget funded by big-money interest groups to spend on radio & television ads, or giant billboards. And we definitely are not using taxpayer dollars to campaign like the incumbent.

**What we have is our small team of staff, and a ton of dedicated volunteers and folks across the district helping to spread the vision of a Wisconsin that benefits everyday folks like you and me.**

[With your help we could reach more and more people in the 5th District and come out on top November 8. Even $5 a week will make a difference.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b6f53613a4&e=356c0699dd)

It's important we have a show of force on this campaign finance report. Any funds we are able to raise will go to communicate directly with voters in the district who are looking for practical solutions to the problems facing us here in Wisconsin.

Thank you for your support. I couldn’t do it without you.

Mike Van Someren

subject: What happens in Alaska matters nationwide
body:
These races are critical to the balance of power in Congress. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d8a254d7ea66/what-happens-in-alaska-matters-nationwide?e=110fec2088)
---
| | [ ](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=b42c2b4ab3&e=110fec2088)
---
| | Dear ,

**Two of the most important elections in America are in Alaska on Nov. 8: Congresswoman Peltola and Senator Murkowski** are key bipartisan voices that make sure Congress gets things done.

As a nonpartisan voice committed to bipartisanship and building back better through infrastructure, **[Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=1af47a4e8b&e=110fec2088) is endorsing both candidates.

[Will you join us in fighting to re-elect Congresswoman Peltola and Senator Murkowski by making a donation of $25 to the Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund?](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=fb49c57006&e=110fec2088)**

Both are running extremely tight re-election campaigns, and **they are the only candidates in their respective races who are _pro-choice_ and _pro-infrastructure_**. We support these campaigns because they have proven through their votes that they will prioritize Alaskans’ and Americans’ best interests, not their own or their party’s.
---
| [SUPPORT INFRASTRUCTURE & CHOICE »](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=c829aa55e0&e=110fec2088 "SUPPORT INFRASTRUCTURE & CHOICE »")
---
| **While Senator Murkowski and Representative Pelota are working with congressional colleagues from both sides of the aisle to build a more sustainable future, Sarah Palin, Kelly Tshibaka, and Nick Begich III are busy fighting** _against_**federal infrastructure funding and** _against_**Americans’ right to choose.**

, all Americans deserve a Congressional delegation that fights for what’s best, and I hope you will help make that happen with a donation to Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund.

**[Will you chip in to Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund today so we can help elect the leaders who will fight for infrastructure and choice?](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=ec3614cfbc&e=110fec2088)**
---
| [DONATE $10 »](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=b2214035d3&e=110fec2088 "DONATE $10 »")
---
| [DONATE $50 »](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=a9be27d4f4&e=110fec2088 "DONATE $50 »")
---
| [DONATE $200 »](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=5bc5ca94ae&e=110fec2088 "DONATE $200 »")
---
| [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT »](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=b3451f1203&e=110fec2088 "DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT »")
---
| Thank you,

Fran Ulmer
Former Lieutenant Governor of Alaska
_Frances “Fran” Ulmer is the outgoing chair of[The Nature Conservancy’s Global Board of Directors](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=ca582ed6d7&e=110fec2088), a senior fellow at [Harvard’s Belfer Center](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=3a8b3714c8&e=110fec2088) and has been a visiting professor both at Stanford and at Harvard’s Institute of Politics. She has served Alaska and northern interests for decades as Alaska’s Lieutenant Governor, state legislator, Mayor of Juneau, Alaska, professor, lawyer, research director, special advisor to the State Department on the Arctic, and Chair of the [U.S. Arctic Research Commission](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=f4dad989e9&e=110fec2088)._

I’m running for governor of Ohio because I believe it’s time for a change.
The same corrupt crew has been running the show in Columbus for far too long now. I know that we can take back this state and get it working again for our families, not Mike DeWine’s corporate backers.
But it’s going to take all of us standing together in these final days.
**[My team has let me know that we need to raise $30,000 in the next few days to stay on track toward our October mid-month fundraising goal. So I’m asking: will you pitch in $5 right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52570100/372669770/-138853854?refcode=nw_em_221013_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Yjk5MmRkYy00YzRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hdYBf4BhvxiI-g8_846TwEC3VRR6RWpJ2vQPgzygjNo=)**
As the mayor of Dayton, I saw some of Ohio’s biggest challenges up close and personal. From the devastating opioid crisis to the COVID-19 pandemic to a mass shooting in our city, Dayton was a microcosm of what so many communities are experiencing across the state.
I worked hard to lead Dayton’s response to these issues -- and I believe it will take someone with that kind of experience to help Ohio come back from the biggest crises we’ve ever seen, not someone with a record of catering to right-wing extremists.
It’s time to turn the page in Columbus and elect a governor who will truly work for the people. And I think that we need more leaders like me from the middle class, not another millionaire.
**But now, time is running out – and I need your help. There has never been a more critical time, so please:**
**[Ohioans are casting their votes and time is running out, team. Stand with me now and make a $5 contribution toward our mid-month fundraising goal.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52570101/372669771/-138853854?refcode=nw_em_221013_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Yjk5MmRkYy00YzRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hdYBf4BhvxiI-g8_846TwEC3VRR6RWpJ2vQPgzygjNo=)**
Onward,
Nan

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker. It’s late and I’m writing from my phone, so I’ll
be brief.

I’m running for Senate in Kentucky because I want my daughters to grow up
in a country where the government doesn’t treat them as second-class
citizens.

My opponent, Rand Paul, has publicly stated that he supports complete
